title: 8 Best Matcha Spots in Bali with Great Flavor
content:
Best matcha in Bali isn’t just a passing trend, it’s now part of the island’s wellness culture and café scene. From smoothie bowls and pancakes to creamy lattes and even ice cream, matcha has found its way onto menus everywhere, from local juice bars to luxury hotels.
Made from finely ground green tea leaves, matcha is loaded with antioxidants that protect the body, while its natural caffeine gives an energizing yet calming boost. More than just a pretty drink, it’s a lifestyle staple in Bali, fueling mornings, inspiring café culture, and keeping wellness at the heart of daily life. Here are 8 best matcha spots in Bali with great flavor!
True to its name, Beige Coffee keeps things minimal and cozy with interiors in soft beige, white, and natural wood. The café may be small and mostly geared for takeout, but the flavor packs a punch. Their coffee is known for being consistently smooth yet bold, making it a local favorite.
But it’s not just about the coffee, this spot is also a must-try for matcha in Bali. Their creamy matcha has just the right touch of bitterness, while the strawberry matcha adds a refreshing sweet-and-sour twist that keeps things exciting.
Location: Jl. Pemelisan Agung, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung
2. KYND Community Canggu
If you’re looking for a standout matcha cafe in Bali, KYND Community is a must. Famous for its pink walls and “Be Kind” mural, this spot is more than just a restaurant, it’s a lifestyle destination.
Perfect for those on their first time in Bali, KYND serves 100% vegan dishes and premium organic matcha. Try their oat milk matcha latte or creamy matcha gelato, all best enjoyed in the cozy space. While it’s technically a cafe in Canggu, it feels like a little world of its own where wellness meets style.
Location: Jalan Petitenget No.12 Kerobokan Kelod, Jl. Petitenget, Seminyak
For anyone into wellness, Matcha Cafe Bali is the go-to spot. This café is all about matcha and healthy eats, from creamy lattes and smoothies to nourishing breakfasts and desserts.
With its white-and-wood interiors and fresh greenery, it’s a bright, relaxing place to recharge. If it’s your first time in Bali, this is the perfect stop after yoga or a surf session to refuel with steady energy minus the coffee jitters.
Location: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.99, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung
If you’re hunting for the best matcha in Seminyak, Mannaka Bali deserves a spot on your list. Located in Kerobokan, this stylish brunch destination is known for beautifully plated dishes made with fresh, high-quality ingredients.
The space blends natural wood, neutral tones, and greenery, giving it a classy yet cozy feel. As a cafe in Seminyak, it’s perfect for breakfast or brunch, with favorites like eggs on homemade sourdough, fresh pastries, smoothies, and coffee, all served in a relaxed Balinese vibe.
Location: Jl. Petitenget No.19C, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung
5. Little Uji Matcha
For those chasing the real taste of Ceremonial Matcha Bali, Little Uji Matcha Cafe is the go-to spot. This cozy cafe focuses on high quality matcha called Uji Matcha, sourced directly from Japan’s Uji region, famous for its rich umami, natural sweetness, and vibrant green hue.
The menu is all about celebrating matcha in its purest form, think hot or iced matcha served traditionally, without drowning it in sugar. With glowing reviews and a focus on authenticity, Little Uji is a must-visit for anyone who wants to experience premium matcha while in Bali.
Location: Jl. Raya Kerobokan No.234x, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung
6. Chontea Ubud Matcha, Japanese Tea & Speciality Coffee
Chontea Ubud brings a touch of Japanese serenity to the heart of Bali’s jungle. As the Ubud branch of the beloved Seminyak brand, it embraces a calm, zen-inspired atmosphere that perfectly matches the town’s peaceful rhythm.
A true sanctuary for tea lovers, this spot serves the finest Matcha Bali Ubud experience, from pure ceremonial-grade matcha whisked by hand to creamy lattes made with almond or oat milk. Whether you’re meditating, reading, or simply unwinding, Chontea Ubud offers a serene escape from the buzz of the café scene.
It’s the kind of place where travelers in Bali can unwind after yoga classes, enjoying a serene cup of matcha in a soothing atmosphere.
Location: Jl. Hanoman, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar
Kurasu, originally from Kyoto, brings its clean and minimalist coffee culture to Bali. Loved by digital nomads and coffee purists, this coffee shop focuses on single-origin beans, hand-brew techniques, and the Japanese philosophy of simplicity.
Beyond coffee, Kurasu also serves high-quality matcha in Bali, offering a smooth, authentic taste that reflects Japan’s tea traditions. They offer a range of matcha selections, from classic blends to premium grades like ceremonial matcha. With its calm, minimalist design, it’s a refreshing escape from the typical tropical café scene.
Location: Jl. Babadan No.89, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
8. The Matcha Bar & Creperie by Remix Juice Co.
The Matcha Bar & Creperie is where health meets indulgence. Known for its wellness drinks and delicious crepes, it’s an extension of Remix Juice Co. and a favorite spot for balancing clean living with sweet cravings.
From energizing matcha smoothies and elixirs to cold-pressed juices packed with vitamins, everything here is crafted for both flavor and wellness.
Location: Jl. Petitenget No.8m, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung
Final Thought on Matcha in Bali
Matcha in Bali is more than a drink; it’s a symbol of balance, mindfulness, and the island’s devotion to wellness. Whether you’re sipping a matcha latte by the rice fields or enjoying it after yoga, every cup reminds you to slow down and savor the moment.
To make your Bali experience even more fulfilling, stay with Ini Vie Hospitality, where comfort meets creativity and every detail is designed for your well-being. Enjoy the perfect blend of relaxation and discovery as you explore Bali’s vibrant café culture from one of our signature villas or resorts.

title: 10 Best Mexican Restaurants in Bali: Tacos, Margaritas & More
content:
Who would have thought that behind the rice fields and beautiful beaches of Bali, you could also find so many great Mexican restaurants? From authentic tacos near the rice paddies to refreshing margaritas by the ocean, Bali offers a surprisingly fun mix of Mexican flavors in different parts of the island.
If you’re craving Mexican food, there are plenty of places worth trying. Whether you want casual tacos, flavorful burritos, or sunset drinks, here are 10 of the best Mexican restaurants in Bali for tacos, margaritas, and more.
Top Mexican Restaurants in Canggu
1. Motel Mexicola Canggu
Motel Mexicola Canggu is one of the most popular spots if you’re looking for the best tacos in Bali while enjoying the lively atmosphere of a cafe in Canggu. Known for its colorful interior, vibrant music, and energetic vibe, this restaurant brings a fun Mexican dining experience close to Batu Bolong Beach.
Some of the must-try menu items include the Tacos de Chorizo and Esquites, a flavorful Mexican-style grilled corn dish. The atmosphere becomes even more exciting at night with DJ music and a tropical party setting that feels fun and very Instagram-worthy.
Located on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No. 117X and the prices usually range from around IDR 150,000 to IDR 400,000 per person. You can visit this restaurant after exploring the popular attractions around Canggu.
2. Lacalita – Oaxacan Meets California
Lacalita Bar y Cocina is a popular Mexican restaurant that Canggu visitors often choose for its relaxed atmosphere, colorful design, and stylish dining experience. Known as one of the well-loved spots in the area, Lacalita Bar y Cocina combines contemporary art touches with authentic Mexican flavors, creating a fun place to enjoy food and drinks with friends.
Some of the highly recommended menu items at Lacalita Bali include the crispy Jalapeño Poppers and their refreshing Margarita selections, perfect for sunset hours. Located on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No. 68, prices usually range from around IDR 100,000 to IDR 300,000 per person.
Origen by Kebun is a great choice for anyone looking for authentic Mexican food in Bali that travelers often recommend. The interior is beautifully designed with creative details that make the atmosphere feel stylish yet comfortable.
Their Birria Tacos are a standout dish, made with slow-cooked meat and fresh handmade corn tortillas prepared daily. Besides tacos, this spot is also popular for flavorful burritos Bali visitors enjoy alongside their signature Mezcal Margaritas, which have a unique smoky taste.
Located on Jl. Pantai Pererenan No. 108, prices usually range from around IDR 200,000 to IDR 500,000 per person. Great place if you are looking for Mexican food with luxury restaurant vibes.
Jalapeño Mexican Kitchen & Bar has become one of the popular spots for Mexico cuisine since first opening in 2014. Known as one of the best Mexican Canggu Bali 2026 destinations, this restaurant brings together fresh local ingredients with authentic Mexican cooking techniques in a relaxed and modern setting.
The atmosphere at jalapeño mexican canggu feels warm, casual, and perfect for dinner with friends. Its interior combines modern desert-inspired touches with the laid-back vibe that Canggu is known for.
The stars of the show are the Beef Quesadillas, Baja Fish Tacos, and the flavorful Cheezy Birria, a perfect spot for Bali Tex Mex food. Located on Jl. Raya Semat, Gg. Anggur No. 1. The prices range from IDR 100,000 to IDR 200,000 per person.
Best Mexican Restaurants in Seminyak
5. Motel Mexicola Seminyak
Famous for its colorful retro-style architecture inspired by traditional Mexican houses, Motel Mexicola Seminyak offers not only good food, but also a fun and lively dining experience. Known as one of the pioneers of the Mexican dining scene in Bali and remains a favorite Mexican cantina in Seminyak, and visitors often recommend it.
The atmosphere feels vibrant, spacious, and full of character, making it a popular stop for people exploring from Seminyak to Canggu. Some of the must-have menu items include their Antojitos, traditional Mexican-style snacks, along with a premium tequila selection that perfectly matches the festive vibe.
Located on Jl. Kayu Jati 9X, Seminyak, prices usually range from around IDR 150,000 to IDR 250,000++ per person.
Taco Casa is a well-known taco restaurant in Bali, popular for its fresh ingredients, consistent flavors, and comfortable atmosphere. The restaurant has a clean and modern design, making it feel welcoming and easy to enjoy for all kinds of guests.
Some of the non-negotiable menu items include the Naked Burrito Bowl and their flavorful Enchiladas, both known for generous portions and fresh toppings. Located on Jl. Petitenget, Seminyak, prices usually range from around IDR 160,000 to IDR 250,000 per person.
Taco Beach Grill is a hidden gem near Seminyak that’s worth visiting if you want a more casual and local-style Mexican dining experience. The restaurant features a simple yet colorful Mexican-inspired design, creating a relaxed atmosphere for lunch or dinner after shopping for a souvenir from Bali or exploring nearby areas.
The menu offers a variety of tacos, enchiladas, and burritos, but one of the most popular dishes is the Babi Guling Tacos. This unique menu combines Bali’s famous roasted pork with rich local spices and soft corn tortillas, creating a flavorful fusion dish many guests come back for. For dessert, they also serve a sugar-free blueberry cheesecake that’s worth trying.
Located on Jl. Pengubengan Kauh, Kerobokan Kelod, North Kuta, prices usually range from around IDR 50,000 to IDR 200,000 per person.
Mexican Food in Ubud & Other Areas
Taco Casa Ubud is one of the most popular Mexican food spots in Bali and has become a favorite for many travelers visiting Ubud. Known for its fresh ingredients and consistent quality, this restaurant prepares everything from scratch, including hand-pressed tortillas and homemade salsa made fresh every day.
Some of the recommended menu items include the 8-inch Super Taco and the Enchiladas, topped with generous cheese and rich, savory red sauce. The atmosphere is casual, comfortable, and great for a relaxed lunch or dinner in Ubud.
Located on Jl. Pengosekan, Ubud, prices usually range from around IDR 75,000 to IDR 200,000 per person.
Cilantro Ubud offers a modern and vibrant Mexican dining experience in the peaceful area of Ubud. This restaurant is known for serving beautifully presented dishes while still keeping authentic Mexican flavors in every menu item.
The atmosphere feels stylish yet comfortable, with modern interiors combined with natural wood accents and greenery that create a warm and elegant setting. It’s a great place for a romantic dinner, casual lunch, or relaxed gathering with friends.
The standout dishes include the Wet Burrito with chicken, enchiladas, and sweet churros for dessert. Located on Jl. Raya Nyuh Kuning, prices usually range from around IDR 50,000 to IDR 150,000 per person.
La Luz offers a different kind of Mexican dining experience in Ubud. Hidden in the peaceful area of Penestanan near Sayan, this restaurant is often known as a creative community space where good food, local art, and relaxed social vibes come together.
The atmosphere feels warm, colorful, and surrounded by lush greenery, making it a comfortable place to spend an afternoon or evening in Ubud. The Beef Rendang Taco, Coconut Ceviche, and their flavorful Nachos Plate are the stars of the show.
Located on Jl. Penestanan, Sayan, Ubud, prices usually range from around IDR 100,000 to IDR 175,000 per person.
Final Thought on Mexican Restaurant in Bali
The difference between Tex-Mex and authentic Mexican restaraunt usually comes from the ingredients and cooking style. Tex-Mex often uses cheddar cheese, wheat tortillas, and bold seasoning, while authentic Mexican dishes focus more on corn tortillas, fresh cheese, and traditional chili flavors.
For a fun night out, start with sunset cocktails by the beach, continue with tacos or burritos for dinner, then end the evening at a lively bar or club nearby. If you prefer a quieter atmosphere, Ubud offers a more relaxed Mexican dining experience surrounded by nature and art.

title: 13 Most Expensive Hotels in the World Explained: What You Really Pay For
content:
The race to become the most expensive hotel in the world continues to reach new heights, with flagship suites now costing anywhere from $60,000 to $235,000 per night in 2026. These extraordinary properties offer far more than luxury accommodations. They deliver once-in-a-lifetime experiences designed for the world’s most discerning travelers.
From personalized butler service to private pools, exclusive amenities, and unmatched privacy, these hotels set the standard for ultra-luxury hospitality. Here’s a look at the 13 most expensive hotels in the world!
The Most Expensive Hotels in the World 2026
1. Lover’s Deep Submarine Hotel – St. Lucia (~$235,000/night)
Unlike a traditional luxury resort, Lover’s Deep is a private submarine that takes guests beneath the Caribbean Sea. With rates of around $235,000 per night, it is widely known as the priciest hotel in the world and one of the most extraordinary honeymoon destinations for couples seeking complete privacy.
The experience includes a captain, private chef, and butler, while the crew remains in a separate soundproof area to ensure guests enjoy total seclusion. Guests can arrive by private speedboat or upgrade to a helicopter transfer before enjoying gourmet dining featuring caviar, fresh oysters, and other premium dishes.
Inside, the submarine features elegant interiors with panoramic windows that reveal colorful coral reefs, historic shipwrecks, and Caribbean marine life throughout the journey. Among the most expensive hotels in the world in 2026, Lover’s Deep stands out for offering something no luxury hotel can replicate: an entirely private underwater stay, personalized service, and a once-in-a-lifetime experience beneath the ocean.
2. Empathy Suite, Palms Casino Resort – Las Vegas (~$100,000/Night)
The Empathy Suite at the Palms Casino Resort is one of the most luxury hotel experiences in Las Vegas, with rates starting at around $100,000 per night. Designed by world-famous artist Damien Hirst, showcasing six original Damien Hirst artworks, including his iconic preserved bull sharks.
The suite also features a private glass-walled pool overlooking the Las Vegas Strip, along with a massage room, salt relaxation room, and private fitness area. Guests enjoy 24-hour butler service, a chauffeured luxury car, and a $10,000 resort credit to spend on dining and entertainment throughout the resort.
As one of the properties with the most expensive hotel per night rates, the Empathy Suite combines world-class contemporary art, ultra-exclusive amenities, and personalized luxury. It’s also a popular choice for bleisure travel, allowing high-profile guests to mix business, entertainment, and an unforgettable luxury stay in one destination.
3. Royal Mansion, Atlantis The Royal – Dubai (~$100,000/Night)
Located at the top of Atlantis The Royal Dubai, the Royal Mansion is one of the most expensive hotel suite world options, with rates of around $100,000 per night. This massive multi-level suite offers breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai’s iconic skyline, combining modern design with the city’s signature luxury.
The interiors feature premium marble, gold accents, and soaring ceilings, while the private infinity pool overlooks Palm Jumeirah. Guests also enjoy a dedicated concierge team that can arrange everything from private yacht charters to exclusive dining experiences at Michelin-starred restaurants.
The Royal Mansion stands out for its exceptional size, unmatched privacy, and personalized service. Combined with its prime location at Atlantis The Royal Dubai, it has become a favorite among celebrities, royal families, and ultra-high-net-worth travelers looking for one of the world’s finest luxury stays.
4. Royal Penthouse, President Wilson Hotel – Geneva (~$80,000/night)
The Royal Penthouse at the President Wilson Hotel is one of Europe’s most prestigious hotel suites, with rates of around $80,000 per night. Occupying the hotel’s entire top floor, this ultra-luxury hotel suite features 12 spacious bedrooms, elegant marble bathrooms, a Steinway grand piano, exclusive Hermès amenities, rare books, and stunning views of Lake Geneva and the Swiss Alps.
Built with heads of state and VIP guests in mind, the penthouse also offers exceptional security, including bulletproof windows, a private elevator, secure access, and a panic button. Guests can also enjoy a formal dining room, a private conference room, and spacious living areas designed for both comfort and privacy.
Blending timeless European elegance with exceptional security, the Royal Penthouse has made the President Wilson Hotel a preferred destination for world leaders, celebrities, and billionaires seeking the highest level of privacy in Geneva.
5. The Muraka, Conrad Maldives Rangali Island – Maldives (~$50,000/Night)
The Muraka at Conrad Maldives Rangali Island is the world’s first two-story underwater villa, offering a truly unique luxury experience for around $50,000 per night. Often mentioned alongside the 7-star hotel world concept, this remarkable villa features an above-water living area with a private pool and sun deck, while the master bedroom is located 5 meters below sea level.
Enclosed beneath a panoramic acrylic dome, guests can fall asleep while watching sharks, rays, and colorful tropical fish swim overhead. The stay also includes a 24-hour butler, private chef, and in-villa spa treatments for complete comfort and privacy.
The Muraka combines cutting-edge engineering with an unforgettable underwater experience that very few places in the world can offer. Blending the luxury of a tropical island resort with the feeling of sleeping beneath the ocean, it delivers a once-in-a-lifetime stay unlike any other.
6. Royal Villa, Grand Resort Lagonissi – Athens (~$50,000/Night)
The Royal Villa at Grand Resort Lagonissi is one of Greece’s most luxurious seaside retreats, with rates starting at around $50,000 per night. Often featured among the most expensive hotels in the world rankings, this private villa sits along the beautiful Athenian Riviera, offering stunning views of the Aegean Sea and complete privacy.
The villa includes two spacious master bedrooms, elegant marble bathrooms, indoor and outdoor heated pools, a private gym, and a dedicated massage area. Guests also enjoy personalized service from a private butler and chef, along with a separate entrance for added security and exclusivity.
The Royal Villa combines beachfront luxury, personalized service, and exceptional privacy in one of Greece’s most exclusive locations. It offers the experience of staying on a private island while remaining just minutes from the mainland, making it a favorite among royalty and high-profile travelers.
7. Penthouse Suite, Hôtel Martinez – Cannes (~$53,000/Night)
Every May, Cannes becomes the center of the film industry, and the Penthouse Suite at Hôtel Martinez is one of its most sought-after addresses. With rates starting at around $53,000 per night, this iconic suite has welcomed actors, producers, and celebrities attending the Cannes Film Festival.
Located on the hotel’s top floor, the suite features one of Europe’s largest private terraces, complete with a Jacuzzi, outdoor dining area, and panoramic views of the Bay of Cannes. Guests also enjoy priority access to Michelin-starred dining and the hotel’s exclusive private beach club.
Its connection to the Cannes Film Festival, prime location on La Croisette, and unmatched privacy have made Hôtel Martinez one of the most luxury hotel experiences on the French Riviera.
8. The Mark Penthouse – New York (~$75,000/Night)
Few hotel suites are as closely connected to the fashion world as The Mark Penthouse. Every year during the Met Gala, it becomes the preferred stay for celebrities preparing before walking one of the world’s most famous red carpets.
Spanning the top two floors of The Mark Hotel, the penthouse offers over 10,000 square feet of living space, a rooftop terrace overlooking Central Park, five bedrooms, six bathrooms, and a private dining room served by Michelin-starred chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
Beyond its luxurious design, The Mark Penthouse offers one of the best locations in Manhattan, exceptional privacy, and an experience tailored for high-profile guests.
9. Faena Penthouse, Faena Miami Beach – Florida, USA (~$76,500/Night)
The Faena Penthouse feels more like a luxury residence than a hotel suite in Florida. Designed by filmmaker Baz Luhrmann and Oscar-winning designer Catherine Martin, every room reflects a dramatic Hollywood-inspired style overlooking Miami Beach.
The two-story penthouse features five bedrooms, spacious living areas, private balconies, and an expansive oceanfront terrace. Guests also receive butler service, private beach access, spa privileges, and exclusive reservations at the hotel’s award-winning restaurants.
Rather than focusing only on size, the Faena Penthouse stands out for its bold design, personalized service, and one of the most exclusive beachfront settings among the most expensive hotel suites in the world.
10. Prince Rainier III Suite, Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo – Monaco (~$70,000/Night)
Inspired by the legacy of Prince Rainier III, this spectacular suite at Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo offers a stay surrounded by Monaco’s royal heritage. With rates starting at around $70,000 per night, the 830-square-meter suite combines timeless elegance with breathtaking views of Monte Carlo and the Mediterranean Sea.
The suite features a two-level terrace with a private heated infinity pool, two luxurious master bedrooms, a private library, elegant living and dining areas, and a marble bathroom with its own steam room. Guests can also enjoy 24-hour butler service, VIP access to Monte-Carlo Beach Club and Thermes Marins Monte-Carlo, plus in-room dining from the three-Michelin-starred Le Louis XV by Alain Ducasse.
The suite pays tribute to Monaco’s royal legacy through an elegant collection of sculptures, paintings, and historical photographs dedicated to Prince Rainier III. Together with impeccable service and spectacular views over Casino Square, it creates an exclusive stay in the heart of Monte Carlo.

Guests also enjoy exclusive access to a hidden white-sand beach via a private funicular, along with an oceanfront spa, wellness facilities, and world-class dining overlooking the Indian Ocean.
Bvlgari Resort Bali delivers an experience that blends privacy, stunning natural surroundings, and authentic Balinese hospitality. Its secluded clifftop location has made it a favorite among celebrities and travelers looking for the ultimate luxury villa Bali escape.

High above Midtown Manhattan, the Ty Warner Penthouse at the Four Seasons Hotel New York is widely regarded as one of the city’s most luxurious hotel suites. Occupying the entire 52nd floor, this 4,300-square-foot residence commands between $78,000 and $80,000 per night and took seven years to complete. The project was brought to life through the collaboration of renowned architect I.M. Pei, acclaimed designer Peter Marino, and hotel owner Ty Warner.
Every detail reflects exceptional craftsmanship, from mother-of-pearl finishes and crystal chandeliers to fabrics woven with gold thread. The suite also features four glass balconies overlooking Manhattan and Central Park, a spa-like marble bathroom, 24-hour butler service, and exclusive use of a Rolls-Royce Phantom with a personal chauffeur.
Created without budget constraints, the Ty Warner Penthouse is more than just a luxury hotel suite. Its striking design, panoramic skyline views, and highly personalized hospitality have secured its reputation as one of the most iconic and exclusive accommodations in New York City.

Sitting above the iconic Claridge’s Hotel in London’s prestigious Mayfair district, The Penthouse at Claridge’s redefines luxury city living. With an estimated rate of $117,000 per night, this 1,100-square-meter rooftop residence offers complete privacy and breathtaking 360-degree views across London’s skyline.
Designed by renowned yacht designer Rémi Tessier, the penthouse features four elegant bedrooms, a rooftop garden with a heated swimming pool, a piano pavilion with a Steinway grand piano, and 75 original artworks by Damien Hirst. Guests also enjoy 24-hour butler service, a private gym with personal training sessions, luxury airport transfers, and helicopter transfers from selected locations.
The Penthouse at Claridge’s combines the elegance of a private art gallery with the comfort of a luxury residence. Its exceptional design, exclusive collection of contemporary art, and prime location in the heart of Mayfair make it one of London’s most remarkable ultra-luxury accommodations.
Exploring the most expensive hotel in the world reveals that true luxury goes far beyond the nightly rate. Whether it’s sleeping beneath the ocean, staying in a palace-like penthouse, or enjoying personalized service in complete privacy, these extraordinary properties offer unforgettable experiences designed for a select few.

title: Mount Agung Bali: Trek Guide, Sacred History & Visitor Tips
content:
Mount Agung is one of the natural wonders you can enjoy on the island of Bali. Located in Karangasem Regency, this mountain is a favorite hiking destination among tourists for its stunning views and beautiful natural landscapes.
Beyond its natural beauty, this 3,142-meter-high mountain also holds deep spiritual value and a long-standing legacy for the local community. If you’re interested in visiting Mount Agung in Bali, read the guide below first to learn about its history, how to hike it, trail guides, safety routes, and tips.
The Sacred Significance of Mount Agung for the Balinese
Mount Agung (Gunung Agung) is Bali’s highest active volcano, towering 3,142 meters above sea level in Karangasem Regency. It has a violent past, marked by a string of eruptions, including the 1963 blast, recorded as one of the deadliest in modern volcanic history.
But ask any local, and you’ll learn this mountain is far more than a striking geological feature. For the Balinese, this mountain is sacred ground, the dwelling place of the gods and the point where life itself is believed to begin.
The meaning of Mount Agung runs so deep that it shapes nearly every aspect of Balinese life, from generations-old legends and the direction homes are built to face the mountain.
The Home of the Gods: According to the Lontar Kutara Kanda Dewa Purana Bangsul, an ancient palm-leaf manuscript central to Balinese Hindu belief, this mountain is called Gunung Toh Langkir, believed to be the seat of the god Mahadewa. Legend has it that Mount Agung is a fragment of Mount Mahameru’s peak, carried to Bali as an anchor to keep the island in balance. In keeping with that sanctity, Besakih Temple stands at the foot of the mountain, Bali’s holiest temple and the bridge connecting people to the divine.
Every Direction Points to the Mountain: Step into any traditional Balinese home or temple, and you’ll notice something quietly deliberate. Everything faces kaja, the sacred direction toward the mountain, a spatial concept rooted in generations of reverence.
A Sanctuary Carved Into the Landscape: Scattered across Agung’s slopes are some of Bali’s most important temples, including Pura Penataran Agung, home to the god Shiva. Once every hundred years, the island gathers here for Eka Dasa Rudra, a grand ceremony held to purify the entire universe.
More Than Just a Mountain: To the Balinese, Mount Agung is a living lesson in harmony between people, nature, and spirit. That philosophy shows up in daily rituals, in the offerings left at its foot, and in the quiet respect locals continue to hold for the land believed to be home to the gods.
Can You Climb Mount Agung?
Although this mountain is held sacred by the local community, climbing Mount Agung in Bali is still allowed. The trail is open to the public, but under a 2025 circular from the Bali Provincial Forestry and Environment Agency (DKLH), hikers are now required to bring a licensed local guide.
Breaking that rule carries serious consequences, especially for foreign tourists. Immigration authorities have already deported several foreign visitors caught hiking without a local guide, a policy put in place to reduce health risks like hypothermia and to respect local customs.
To start your climb, you must register at an official post first, either Pura Pasar Agung in Sebudi Village, Selat, or Pura Besakih in Rendang, Karangasem. Local guides can be arranged through the management at these posts or the mountain guide association in Karangasem.
Keep in mind that the trail isn’t always open. Hiking is often paused temporarily out of respect for traditional Balinese Hindu ceremonies. Typically during the sacred religious month around March or April or during certain other periods, so it’s important to check local updates on closures beforehand.
Climbing is also prohibited during extreme weather or increased volcanic activity. Mount Agung currently sits at Level I (Normal), based on data from MAGMA Indonesia, the official platform managed by PVMBG (Center for Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation). So it remains safe to climb as long as hikers stay within the safe radius and avoid the crater area.
Trekking Routes to Mount Agung
If you want to hike Mount Agung in Bali but don’t know where to start, here’s a quick trekking guide to the main routes.
Route 1 – Pura Pasar Agung (Most Common)
If you want to hike Mount Agung to catch the sunrise, starting from the Pura Pasar Agung route is the most common choice. Most hikers start around 2 to 3 in the morning, and this southern route in Selat Village, Karangasem, takes around 3 to 4 hours up and roughly the same time back down.
This trail is popular because its starting point already sits at around 1,600 meters above sea level, taking you up to the crater rim, the second peak, at roughly 3,031 meters. Despite being shorter than other routes, the track is still steep and challenging, with terrain that moves through dense forest, then volcanic rock, and open areas near the top where hikers often rely on fixed ropes to help them climb.
Route 2 – Pura Besakih (Summit Route)
If you want to reach the true summit at 3,142 meters above sea level, Pura Besakih offers the best Mount Agung trek to the top. Reaching the crater rim from this route takes around 6 to 8 hours, longer than the Pura Pasar Agung trail.
This route is usually less common among beginner hikers, but it’s favored by experienced climbers since it’s the only official trail that reaches the true peak, despite being longer and more challenging. The terrain is dominated by thick tropical forest at the start of the climb, then shifts into steep, energy-draining slopes, slippery sandy ground, gravel, and large volcanic rocks all the way up.
What to Expect on the Climb
Climbing Mount Agung can be an incredible way to experience a holiday in Bali, beyond its beaches. As the island’s highest mountain, it offers a spiritual experience alongside a genuinely challenging adventure.
You’ll need to be ready for extreme terrain, freezing temperatures, and a set of sacred local customs that must be respected. Here’s what to expect on your Mount Agung hike:
Trail terrain: The route winds through dense forest and steep, rocky ground, with a fairly long travel time for a single trip. Many hikers set off in the early hours of the morning, guided only by headlamps.
Views: Reaching the top rewards you with a stunning 360-degree panorama, including a sea of clouds, Mount Rinjani, and the open ocean in the distance.
Temperature and weather: Temperatures can drop drastically at night, sometimes into the low single digits Celsius, often accompanied by strong winds.
Local rules: A local guide is mandatory for safety. There’s also a strict customary law against bringing gold jewelry or beef-based food on the climb.
Practical Guide: How to Plan Your Mount Agung Trek
If you want a smooth hiking experience at this sacred volcano in Bali, you’ll need to plan well ahead of time. Here are a few tips:
Set your departure date. You can reach out to the local trail management for updates on route openings, or use a local travel agency in Bali to arrange a guide.
Choose a route that matches your experience level and time, whether it’s Pura Pasar Agung for a shorter climb, or Pura Besakih for a longer, more challenging one.
Make sure you’ve arranged transportation or rented a car to reach the hiking post.
Budget for the climb. Entrance fees are around Rp50,000 (roughly $3) for Indonesian citizens and Rp100,000 (roughly $6) for foreign visitors, and since a local guide is mandatory for safety, expect to pay around Rp600,000 to 750,000 (roughly $34 to $42) for one.
Build your physical stamina to handle the steep terrain and extreme inclines toward the summit. Cardio training like running, swimming, or stair climbing at least two weeks before the hike can go a long way.
Respect local customs and traditions, such as not climbing while in a state considered impure, like women on their period or those with a recently deceased family member. Also avoid gold jewelry, skip beef-based food during the climb, and watch your words and behavior along the trail.
Prices and exchange rates are estimates only and may change, so it’s best to confirm current rates before your trip.
Where to Stay Near Mount Agung
One practical way to prepare for a Mount Agung hike is to stay somewhere close to the mountain. That way, all your preparations become easier, and you won’t have to make a long, exhausting journey, especially if you’re starting the climb before dawn.
There are plenty of accommodation options near the mountain and its hiking trails, and here are a few worth considering:
Hideout Eco Bamboo House Bali: A hidden gem tucked into Mount Agung’s slopes, located on Jalan Jangu, Selat, Karangasem Regency. This property is built around a bamboo concept that blends into the surrounding nature, offering deep tranquility before or after your climb. Rooms start at Rp2,997,129 (roughly $167) per night, letting you stay just steps from the mountain.
The Payung House: For a more affordable option, this property in Bebandem is worth considering. Prices start around Rp1,378,364 (roughly $77) per night. You’ll stay at the foot of Mount Agung in a wooden stilt house that blends naturally into its surroundings.
Puri Agung Inn: For budget travelers, this is a solid pick, with rooms starting from around Rp300,000 (roughly $17) per night. Though simpler, it still offers comfort and easy access to the mountain trailhead, located on Baledan Street, Selat, right near the mountain.
Climbing Mount Agung isn’t just a demanding physical challenge; it’s a chance to experience a view most tourists never see from Bali’s highest point. With a solid understanding of the mountain, careful preparation, respect for local rules and traditions, and the right place to stay, this sacred climb can become one of the most memorable parts of your trip.

Tucked in lush greenery, this resort blends Balinese charm with a modern artistic touch. It’s ideal for couples or small groups looking for a quiet, refined space to unwind. Choose from a villa in Ubud with private pools, a jacuzzi suite, or a cozy family setup, each one made for comfort and calm.
The on-site Cantina Classe brings Italy to the tropics with handmade pasta, soulful dishes, and rustic flavors served in a warm, garden setting. For those seeking holistic wellness, Svaha Spa Maar is all about gentle, grounding treatments inspired by Balinese rituals. It’s a tranquil haven where you can recharge fully, making it one of the best resorts in Bali for adults looking for serenity off the beaten path.
Experience the Newest Romantic Getaway in Bali
Every new resorts in Bali 2026 brings something fresh to the island. More beauty, more luxury, and more reasons to visit. From Uluwatu’s scenic cliffs to Ubud’s serene jungle, these standout resorts redefine the art of escape, especially for couples chasing romance and relaxation.
If you’re planning a dreamy getaway or a romantic honeymoon, these destinations deliver the perfect balance of privacy, design, and wellness. For next-level service and thoughtfully crafted stays, trust Ini Vie Hospitality, they continue to lead the way in offering the best hospitality in Bali.

title: New Year’s Eve 2026 in Bali: Events, Parties, and Packages
content:
Let’s celebrate new year’s eve 2026 in Bali is a fantastic experience, combining a warm tropical vibe with exciting celebrations across the island. From world-class beach club parties to stunning fireworks along the coastline, Bali offers a lively and memorable way to welcome the new year.
In this article, you’ll find recommendations for the best places to celebrate the New Year in Bali. Get ready for a New Year’s Eve 2026 that feels truly special, complete with vibrant festivities and eco-minded hospitality.
Events in Bali for New Year’s Eve 2026
Ankhusa offers one of the most memorable Bali New Year 2026 events with its Grand Cultural Dance Gala. Enjoy an elegant evening filled with iconic Balinese performances such as Legong, Barong, Topeng, Cendrawasih, Jauk, Teruna Jaya, and Joged dances, all paired with a delicious New Year’s Eve dinner.
This unique blend of gourmet dining and cultural heritage creates a magical celebration to welcome the new year. Ankhusa is located inside Aksari Resort Ubud on Jl. Raya Kenderan No. 88 A.
Celebrate New Year’s Eve in style with two exciting celebration sessions at Tsune Uluwatu. Start your evening with an exclusive Dinner Set Menu from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM, priced at IDR 750,000++ or IDR 799,000++ per person, with the higher option including a glass of wine.
At 10:00 PM, the celebration continues at the main pool area, where the party becomes even livelier. For IDR 350,000++ per person, enjoy free-flow cocktails and canapés, a live DJ, and a fun pool party complete with floats until midnight, ending with a beautiful fireworks display at 12:00 AM.
Tsune Uluwatu is a modern Japanese restaurant with stunning ocean views, located in the Seascape Uluwatu complex on the peninsula hill, a perfect spot for a vibrant New Year’s celebration.
Celebrate New Year’s Eve 2026 with Unforgettable Parties
Celebrate New Year’s Eve with an unforgettable night at The Jungle Club Ubud! Join the New Year’s Eve Odyssey Showcase, bringing you One Last Wild Night before stepping into 2026. The celebration will feature exciting live performances from DJs Fake Mood and Alexey Izotov, setting the perfect high-energy mood to welcome the new year.
The Jungle Club is a popular day club just outskirt Ubud, known for its stunning jungle views, crystal-clear river, and a beautiful infinity pool overlooking the treetops. It’s an incredible spot to wrap up the year in style. You can find it at Jl. Jaga Raga No. 8A, Celuk.
Tropical Temptation Beach Club
Celebrate a dreamy and unforgettable New Year’s Eve at Tropical Temptation Beach Club with the special “Awakened Dreamers” event. Enjoy a magical beachfront celebration on Melasti Beach as the sun sets and the night comes alive.
The party begins on Wednesday, December 31 at 5:00 PM, featuring performances by Shan Nash, Ritual Frequencies (Live Set), Jazzy O, and Slava Lee. Dress in your best boho chic outfit to match the vibe, and keep in mind that this adults-only event officially starts at 2:00 PM.
At midnight, the club will also feature a festive fireworks display to welcome the new year. It’s a nice highlight to end the night, so be sure to catch it.
Celebrate New Year’s Eve 2026 with Ini Vie Hospitality Accommodation Package
For a memorable year-end holiday and New Year’s Eve Bali celebration, Ini Vie Hospitality offers special accommodation deals you won’t want to miss. You can book the Last Chance Holiday Escape promo until December 20, 2025, and enjoy a flexible stay period through January 31, 2026.
To make your Bali New Year’s Eve even better, there’s also an End Year Sale with big discounts. This offer is valid for bookings from December 12–30, 2025, with stays available from December 1, 2025, to March 31, 2026, just use promo code SALE12 at checkout to enjoy the best rate.
Ini Vie Hospitality accommodations are located in Ubud, Sanur, Canggu, Seminyak, Tabanan, and Uluwatu. You can choose the atmosphere you want to end the year in.
Celebrate the New Year with an Unforgettable Dinner Package at Our Restaurant
Celebrate the Festive Season leading up to Bali New Year 2026 with a special dining experience at Cantina Classe! Enjoy a luxurious dinner and get an exclusive treat by spending a minimum of IDR 1,000K. You’ll receive one complimentary option, Wine, Cocktail, Dessert, or a 20% Discount on your total bill.
This offer is available from December 24 to 31, 2025. You may choose only one complimentary benefit, and all Wine, Cocktail, and Dessert selections will be specially curated by the team. It’s a perfect choice for those looking for romantic things to do in Bali during the festive season.
Celebrate Bali New Year 2026 events with a fun and interactive Japanese dining experience at Shichirin Canggu! Enjoy a 10% discount during the New Year period with a minimum spend of IDR 500,000++, perfect for adding a special meal to your Bali holiday packages.
Shichirin Canggu serves authentic Japanese dishes and is conveniently located on Jl. Pemelisan Agung Pantai Berawa No. 88, just steps away from Berawa Beach. It’s a good time to visit Bali in New Year, and enjoying this set menu before watching fireworks nearby makes the celebration even better.
3. Kojin Japanese Restaurant
Celebrate the new year in Bali with an elegant and authentic Japanese dining experience at Kojin Japanese Restaurant Ubud.
Enjoy their Kaiseki Festive Flavors, a beautifully crafted multi-course menu featuring premium seasonal ingredients, now with a 15% discount starting from IDR 1,000,000++ per person, including a signature cocktail. This special offer is available on December 24 and December 31, 2025, with reservations required before December 20.
Kojin serves Kaiseki, a luxurious Japanese dining style known for its artistry and refined flavors, perfect for festive celebrations. The restaurant sits inside Aksari Resort, one of the charming boutique hotels in Ubud, located at Jl. Raya Desa Kenderan No. 88 A, offering a serene setting for an unforgettable holiday meal.
Celebrate Bali New Year’s Eve with bold and authentic Indian flavors at Sans Indian Ubud. Enjoy a special Festive Set Menu designed to welcome 2026 with delicious dishes and a warm dining atmosphere.
You can choose the Non-Vegetarian Set (IDR 575K++), featuring Vegetable Samosa, Tamatar Ka Shorba, Murgh Tikka Masala or Indian Curry Lamb with Paratha, and Crème Brûlée, complete with a glass of wine or Passion Fruit Berry. The Vegetarian Set (IDR 450K++) includes Papadum Masala, Vegetable Kolhapuri with Chapati, Gajar Ka Halwa, and a glass of wine or a cocktail.
It’s a flavorful way to start the new year while enjoying Bali’s festive energy and preparing for simple travel requirements like the tourist tax. Sans Indian is located inside the Dedary Resort complex at Banjar Pinjul No. 8, Kenderan, Tegallalang, Ubud. Enjoy a spice-filled celebration to welcome 2026!
5. Norii Japanese Restaurant
Start your Bali New Year 2026 with delicious flavors at Norii. Their special set menu includes a Pork Skewer starter, Exotic Mushroom Soup, and a choice of Steamed Fish Roll or Grilled Wagyu Tenderloin Steak, ending with Classic Fried Banana and a Lychee Martini or Tequila Sunrise.
It’s a warm and flavorful way to welcome the new year. Norii is located inside the Amarea Resort complex at Jl. Sawah Indah Gang Amarea No. 8, Peliatan, Ubud, perfect for guests staying at nearby boutique hotels in Bali
Celebrate Bali New Year 2026 events with an elegant dinner at Habitat Bistro. Their New Year’s Dinner Set Menu (IDR 550,000++ per person) includes Mosaic Fish as an appetizer, a choice of Beef Tenderloin or Chicken Roulade for the main course, and Pistachio Panna Cotta for dessert, along with a glass of house wine or a cocktail.
The evening becomes even more festive with Live Acoustic and Fire Dance performances from 7:00–8:30 PM on December 31. Habitat Bistro is located inside Kaamala Resort, Jl. Monkey Forest No. 88X, close to Ubud Palace and other popular attractions.
Start your Bali New Year 2026 celebrations with a vibrant Japanese dining experience at Shichirin Ubud. Their special set menu features Salmon Tartare Sandwich, Calamari Teppanyaki, Moshi Crab Meat Soup, a Gyukatsu main course, and a sweet Wagashi Mochi dessert.
The package also includes your choice of house wine, cocktail, or mocktail to complete the evening. Shichirin Ubud is located at Kaamala Resort, Jl. Monkey Forest No. 88X, perfect for a festive dinner.
8. Ankhusa Restaurant
Celebrate New Year’s Eve with a delicious BBQ Buffet Dinner at Ankhusa! For IDR 850,000++ per person, you can enjoy a generous spread of dishes to welcome the new year.
Start your meal with a fresh salad bar and warm Soto Ayam, then head to the Grill Station for seafood and meat favorites like Grilled Tiger Prawns, Chicken Breast, Beef Short Ribs, White Fish, and Pork Skewers. You can also enjoy comforting sides such as Potato Wedges, Herb Rice, and Grilled Corn Cob, and finish with sweet treats like Chocolate Mousse and Onde-Onde.
Ankhusa is located at Aksari Resort complex, featured lush greenery and semi-open space. Enjoy your dining with magnificent view. Book early between November 1–30, 2025, to enjoy a 10% Early Bird Discount!
9. Cantina Classe Ubud
Celebrate Bali New Year 2026 and Christmas with a romantic 3-course dinner at Cantina Classe. For IDR 590,000 per couple, you’ll enjoy a Caesar Salad starter, Spicy King Prawn Fettuccine, and a sweet Red Velvet dessert paired with exclusive wines.
Available from December 21, 2025, to January 21, 2026, this cozy Italian restaurant sits near peaceful rice paddies and offers a beautiful garden view, perfect for a festive date night. Located at Jl. Drupadi, Melinggih,. Payangan.
Ring in Bali New Year’s 2026 events with a lively celebration at Tsune Sanur starting at 6:00 PM on December 31. Enjoy live saxophone performances and a special treat, free sushi served from a canoe-style river boat for the first 30 guests.
This authentic Japanese restaurant, famous for Bali’s first floating sushi concept, offers stunning ocean views and a refreshing semi–open-air setting. It’s the perfect way to enjoy great food, music, and festive energy before continuing your celebration around Bali. Located at the top of Seascape Sanur, on Jl. Aruna No.8A, Sanur.
Refresh and Rejuvenate for New Year’s 2026 Package at Our Spa & Wellness Retreat
1. Svaha Spa Kenderan
Start your journey into 2026 feeling calm and refreshed with the New Year Rejuvenation Treat at Svaha Spa Kenderan. Enjoy an exclusive 20% discount on the luxurious 180-minute Jungle Package when you book between December 1–20, 2025.
This peaceful spa sits inside Aksari Resort in Kenderan Village, offering a quiet escape with beautiful forest and valley views, perfect for anyone needing soothing me-time before the celebrations begin.
Welcome the New Year with total relaxation at Svaha Spa Bisma. Their special “Start Your New Year with Pure Relaxation” package includes a 60-minute Traditional Balinese Massage and a 30-minute Body Scrub for only IDR 1,000,000 per person, available from January 1–10, 2026.
Located within Kaamala Resort in central Ubud, this spa offers a refreshing, nature-inspired atmosphere, ideal for recharging your body and mind as you step into 2026.
End the year with a refreshing glow through the Teges Festive Glow Package! Enjoy 90 minutes of pure relaxation with your choice of Aromatherapy or Deep Tissue Massage, plus a FREE 30-minute Express Facial for naturally radiant skin.
This special offer is available throughout December 2025 and January 2026. Located inside Amarea Resort Ubud, Svaha Spa Teges offers a peaceful retreat surrounded by lush forest, and it also has great options for couples to enjoy together.
Treat yourself to deep relaxation with the Dedary Festive Indulgence package. This soothing 90-minute Aromatherapy Massage comes with a FREE Milk Bath, giving you the perfect chance to unwind during the festive season.
The offer runs through December 2025 and January 2026. Set among rice fields and tropical gardens, Svaha Spa Dedary combines traditional Balinese designs with a luxurious atmosphere, making it an ideal spot to recharge.
5. Svaha Spa at Maar
Step into the holiday season with full relaxation through the Festive Wellness Treat at Svaha Spa at Maar! Enjoy a special 25% discount on the Maar Touch Signature Massage throughout December 2025 and January 2026, giving you the perfect chance to refresh your body and mind before welcoming 2026.
This intimate spa offers a classic, calming atmosphere with beautiful garden views and a cool, luxurious interior. You’ll find it inside Maar Resort Ubud, an ideal spot for anyone wanting a peaceful spa escape.
Give yourself the gift of tranquility this festive season at Svaha Spa Kelusa. Enjoy a 25% discount on the Sacred Kelusa Touch Signature Massage during December 2025 and January 2026, designed to help you unwind and reset your energy for the new year.
Located at Asvara Resort Ubud, this spa offers sweeping 180-degree rice field views, letting you relax to the sound of birds and nature. It’s the perfect place to recharge before stepping into 2026.
What Makes the New Year Celebration in Bali So Special?
1. Eco-Conscious Travel
Bali is becoming more focused on eco-conscious travel, which fits naturally with the island’s spiritual values. Many resorts in Ubud and Uluwatu now offer luxurious New Year experiences with minimal environmental impact, using bamboo architecture, reducing plastic waste, and improving energy and water efficiency.
Instead of only attending parties, visitors can welcome the new year through yoga, meditation, or dinner made with locally sourced ingredients, supporting farmers and lowering carbon footprints. Equipoise Resort in Ubud is one example, offering stunning 180-degree rice field views and sustainable design throughout the property. This thoughtful approach makes celebrating the new year in Bali feel more meaningful and balanced.
2. High Season but Affordable Options
Even though New Year’s is peak season and accommodation prices rise, Bali still provides many budget-friendly ways to celebrate. New Year’s Eve parties in Bali cost differently depending on the venue, and while gala dinners at luxury resorts may reach Rp1.5–5 million++, many beach clubs offer cheaper presale tickets or even free access to beachside fireworks in areas like Kuta, Seminyak, and Canggu.
Families can also find special deals such as discounted children’s packages or all-inclusive stays that cover rooms, breakfast, and gala dinners. With so many choices, it’s easy to enjoy the holiday without overspending.
3. Fireworks Across the Island
Fireworks are a big part of New Year’s celebrations, and Bali offers one of the most spectacular displays thanks to its coastal setting. Instead of happening in just one place, fireworks light up the entire shoreline, especially in Seminyak and Canggu, where major beach clubs create synchronized shows reflected beautifully on the ocean.
In Uluwatu, cliffside resorts and venues like GWK Cultural Park launch fireworks from above, giving visitors a dramatic, unforgettable view. And with many attractions open, Bali is not fully closed on January 1st, making it easy to continue exploring the island after the celebrations.
Best Areas to Stay in Bali for New Year’s Eve
Canggu is a hotspot for young travelers and creatives, offering a trendy and energetic vibe. New Year’s Eve here centers around major beach clubs in Bali like Finns Beach Club and Atlas Beach Club, known for massive parties, international DJs, and crowds that dance until sunrise.
If you want a high-energy celebration, Canggu is the perfect choice. The area also has plenty of stylish villas and boutique stays, such as Atap Resort Canggu, Astera Resort Canggu, and Nara Villa, great for groups celebrating together.
Seminyak offers a more elegant and upscale New Year’s scene, ideal for travelers who want something polished but still lively. Iconic spots like Ku De Ta and Potato Head host luxurious dinners and top-tier parties with beautiful fireworks.
The area is filled with romantic villas and five-star stays like Sini Vie Resort, Aksari Villa Seminyak, and Cyrus Villa, making it perfect for couples looking to combine celebration with relaxation. It’s one of the most refined attractions in Bali for NYE.
Sanur is a peaceful alternative to the busier party hubs, offering a calm and family-friendly New Year’s atmosphere. Hotels along the beach often host simple dinners with acoustic music or cultural performances, making it great for travelers who prefer a relaxed celebration.
Its east-facing beachfront gives you a serene first sunrise of the year, perfect for a reflective start. Sanur is ideal for families, seniors, and anyone who wants a quiet beach escape.
Uluwatu delivers one of the most exclusive and scenic New Year’s experiences in Bali. Perched on dramatic cliffs overlooking the Indian Ocean, luxury resorts host intimate dinners and parties with breathtaking sunset views.
Fireworks seen from the clifftop feel magical and unforgettable. With world-class villas and infinity pools facing the ocean, Uluwatu is perfect for honeymooners or those who prioritize privacy, beauty, and high-end comfort.
Fireworks Everywhere in Bali
Canggu, especially the Batu Bolong and Berawa areas, is known for its huge beach clubs like FINNS and Atlas, which put on impressive fireworks shows. The atmosphere is energetic, trendy, and the parties usually continue until early morning.
2. Garuda Wisnu Kencana (GWK)
GWK Cultural Park often hosts large New Year’s Eve events with coordinated fireworks displays you can watch from above. Tickets are required and should be purchased beforehand.
Kuta Beach is the main spot for crowd-filled fireworks celebrations. Hotels, beach bars, and visitors set off their own fireworks, creating a lively and festive yet free New Year’s experience.
Jimbaran offers a more relaxed vibe with its famous beachfront seafood restaurants. You can enjoy the fireworks in a more romantic, less crowded setting compared to Kuta or Canggu.
Mertasari Beach in Sanur is calm and family-friendly, with fireworks visible along the entire coastline. It’s also a popular place to catch the first sunrise of the new year.
6. Tropical Temptation
Tropical Temptation Beach Club is one of Uluwatu’s most popular spots, set on the beautiful shores of Melasti Beach. With its boho-inspired design, adults-only vibe, and amazing ocean views, it’s an ideal place to celebrate the new year.
They’re also hosting the Awakened Dreamers: Dreamy Beachfront NYE event, offering a night filled with music, good energy, and a relaxed boho-chic atmosphere by the sea. The venue features an infinity pool and stylish beachfront cabanas, making the celebration even more memorable.
Celebrate New Year’s Eve with one last unforgettable night in the heart of Ubud’s natural beauty. The Jungle Club Ubud presents the New Year’s Eve Odyssey Showcase, blending lively energy with deep, rhythmic music. With its bohemian style, bamboo architecture, and lush jungle surroundings, the atmosphere feels vibrant yet calming, an experience you can only find in Ubud.
Tips for Spending New Year’s Eve in Bali
1. Book Your Stay and Tickets Early
New Year’s Eve is one of Bali’s busiest seasons, so make sure to reserve your hotel, villa, and event tickets ahead of time. Popular beach clubs and dinner venues in areas like Canggu and Uluwatu fill up quickly, and prices usually rise after early December.
2. Plan Your Transportation
Roads in Kuta, Seminyak, and Legian often become very crowded or even closed around midnight. Arrange your taxi or online transport (Gojek/Grab) in advance, or settle a price with a local driver so you’re not stuck waiting. Avoid relying on last-minute transport or riding your own motorbike.

title: 9 Wildest Night Club Bali Spots: Your Ultimate Guide to Island Party Life
content:
Your trip would not be complete without experiencing a party in night club Bali. Nightclubs have become the must-visit attractions for tourists on the island.
Because Bali is known for its party life, tourists need to research about night club in Bali to visit. So, let’s dive into the explanation of 9 wildest Night Club Bali Spots for a ultimate guide to island party life.
The Bali Nightlife Scene in 2026
Bali nightlife in 2026 is growing more interesting for tourists because there are many nightlife spots to explore. Different areas give different vibes to them, and several places are even fancy, while others are chill.
From night clubs to cafes with the best barista, you can choose the places you prefer. That is why knowing the Bali night club is the first step to having a memorable party all night.
Most of Bali’s nightlife hotspots are located along the southern coast, including Kuta, Seminyak, and Canggu. You can get amazing views if you go further south, such as Uluwatu, with drinks served by the best bartenders.
This guide will help you to choose the preferred night club Bali, so you will have an amazing nightlife experience during the trip.
Seminyak’s Iconic Party Scene
You can find a lot of iconic party scenes when visiting Seminyak with its clubs. Nightlife there is highly recommended because every club provides you with its best service. A modern lounge, high-beat dance floor, or place to chill is available in the area. Here are four night club bali spots in Seminyak to visit:
1. ShiShi Nightclub & Izakaya
You will enjoy the lounge with eclectic lamps when visiting ShiShi Nightclub and Izakaya. This club has a Japanese concept, so it serves a Japanese type of food with RnB music playing, giving a really chill atmosphere. ShiShi Nightclub and Izakaya is the perfect place for you to have a chill night life in Bali with friends or even lovers.
Because ShiShi Nightclub & Izakaya is not that far from the beach, you can check several hotels located near it, therefore, you remain able to go to the beach after having a great night there.
Address: Jl. Petitenget No.208X, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
Another Bali night club using eclectic lamps is La Favela in Seminyak. The place itself is quite iconic because there is a Jesus statue inside the club.
La Favela is suitable for a big night out since the place is loud, packed, chaotic, and ridiculously fun. Tourists will experience fantastic and memorable parties in this night club Bali during the trip.
Address: Jl. Laksamana Basangkasa No.177X, Seminyak, Kec. Kuta, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
3. Mirror Lounge & Bar
Enjoying Bali nightlife is not yet fulfilled if you miss Mirror Lounge & Bar in Seminyak. Known for its dramatic ambiance, the venue delivers an unforgettable clubbing experience from the moment you step inside.
It also has features of intricate stained glass windows and towering vaulted ceilings, making it look captivating for you as a guest. As a Bali night club, Mirror Lounge & Bar serves you with various types of drinks, such as Hendricks gin and Glenlivet whiskey, ensuring you to have a perfect sip in every moment you are enjoying.
Address: Jl. Petitenget Seminyak No.106, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
Motel Mexicola is really popular among tourists, known for serving authentic Mexican dishes. The place successfully sets the bar very high, offering a nice-looking venue for you upon arrival
At least, you should come to Motel Mexicola once to have a fantastic party experience because the place has a lot of delicious food and diverse kinds of drinks to enjoy.
Address: Jl. Kayu Jati No.9X, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
They are all night club Bali spots that you can enjoy in Seminyak. The places are not limited to them because you can also experience nightlife in Canggu.
Canggu’s Underground & Beach Vibes
In Canggu, you can enjoy the relaxed yet energetic nightlife atmosphere, blending underground music culture with beachfront party vibes. The area has several famous beach clubs and night clubs near it. Here is the list of night club Bali in Canggu that you can visit:
Atlas Superclub has become one of the most popular night clubs that tourists love to visit. The place is an indoor venue with three floors, combined with industrial-chic, giving a new type of entertainment in ambiance.
In addition, Atlas Superclub also provides you with:
Multi-Level Experience: The first floor is the center of entertainment, while the second floor offers you a wraparound view. If you want to have a private room, you can go to the third floor, which includes a private bar, karaoke, and PlayStation.
Seven Thematic Nights: Every single night has different vibes, for instance, Afro Night on Monday, Ladies Night on Tuesday, Dirty Dutch on Wednesday, and Resurgence Techno on Thursday.
Immersive Production: You will enjoy the dance while being highlighted with 1.000 laser lights and a screen using kinetic technology rigging.
Address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.88, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
Vault is a new bar established in the Canggu area. It was created by a collective of Western and Indonesian friends working together in the underground music scene for decades. According to the Vault website, the owner wanted to craft something to offset the beautiful palm tree in Bali.
This party place has always been a spot for people to admire the creativity of others. You can find your preference in tribe, dance, and drink until the sun comes up. Having a electrifying night in the Vault will become an unforgettable memory for you.
Address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.99, Tibubeneng, Badung, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
Last but not least, for the Canggu restaurant and bar to visit is Sand Bar. It is a free entry place that is perfect for backpackers and locals; they are allowed to enter the bar wearing casual style and sandals to enjoy Bali night life there.
Sand Bar offers you a nice view of the ocean and sunset. You can take a lot of pictures, capturing all the beauty of Bali’s scenery. You should put Sand Bar on the list of a night club in Bali and visit it immediately when you arrive on the island.
Address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali
If you have ever visited those three night clubs in Bali, you can choose a night club Bali in Uluwatu to have a different experience in enjoying nightlife.
Uluwatu’s Cliffside Raves
Although the place is located at the very tip of Bali, Uluwatu has pretty scenery and diverse drinks to enjoy the nightlife. There are two recommended Bali night club located in Uluwatu, including:
8. Tropical Temptation Beach Club
Tropical Temptation Beach Club has become a famous place for you to enjoy a party night in Uluwatu. The place offers panoramic views and cabanas, making you want to stay for a long time there.
With a tribal bohemian concept, the beach club only allows adults to come in. You will experience the luxurious bohemian atmosphere in the calm shores of Uluwatu, so that you can immediately reserve the place to immerse yourself in one of the prettiest Bali night clubs in Uluwatu.
It is highly recommended for you to stay in an accommodation near Tropical Temptation Beach Club to ease you move from the place to rest to the entertainment place.
Address: Melasti Beach 88, Uluwatu, Jl. Melasti, Ungasan, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
Last but not least, you can write Savaya Bali on your Bali night club list before arriving on the island. The place is nestled between wild, pretty jungle and soaring limestone cliffs 100 meters above the Indian Ocean.
To visit the place, you should know that the entry tickets are only sold through the Savaya Bali Megatix Channel. Buying tickets from unauthorized sources will not be permitted, so you should be careful. In addition, Savaya Bali strictly imposes a 21+ policy and valid ID upon entry.
Also, it is recommended to book a hotel or villa in Uluwatu before you visit Savaya Bali, so you will not feel worried about the place to stay there. Several hotels even have a panoramic view of the Indian Ocean and close to the bar.
Address: Jl. Belimbing Sari, Banjar Tambiyak, Pecatu, Uluwatu, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80364
That’s all night club Bali spots to visit for you. To make your night truly unforgettable, you should follow these tips below before attending any event in the Bali night club.
Tips for the Ultimate Night Out in Bali
Understanding the tips will help you to make your trip fun and fulfilling. These tips include FDC, dress code, transportation, and traffic, so you will not make any mistakes in enjoying a night in Bali.
First Drink Charge (FDC): The FDC clubs typically range from Rp 100.000 to 250.000+ per pax, including a drink voucher. A major night club in Bali, such as Atlas Super Club and ShiShi, requires men to pay around 150.000 – 250.000 and free entry for women. It is important to prepare your money so that you can pass the entry easily.
Dress Code: Every night club has its own dress code preference. Usually, the night club prohibits guests from wearing basic sandals and requires them to dress casually. Choosing comfort and breathable fabrics like linen or cotton is perfect to keep the body from the heat.
Transportation and Traffic: Most people in Bali heavily rely on private vehicles or a rental car/motorcycle. Traffic can be very heavy in areas such as Canggu, Seminyak, and Ubud, particularly in peak hours. For convenience, you can choose GoRide, Grabbike, or even walk to the destinations.
Due to the chaotic traffic, booking a villa near the party area will make your night more convenient. There are several night clubs near the villa in Bali, so you will not have to pay for the rental or online transportation.
Best Villas Near the Party Zones
You can choose a villa near the night club Bali to save money. If you want to experience Bali night life in Seminyak, you should book Sana Vie Villa Seminyak by iNi Vie Hospitality, which is located in Jalan Gn. Tangkuban Perahu No.888A, Seminyak, Kuta Utara, Bali. The luxury villa offers an intimate experience for the guests after having a perfect night in a Bali night club. Also, it has a romantic ambiance which is suitable for lovebirds who have a honeymoon after marriage.
Aside from Seminyak, you can also book a villa around Canggu. There are a lot of night clubs near the villa that can help you to save more money on accommodation. One of them is Canggu Circle Villa, which is located in Jalan Danau Batur Gg. Mangga VIII No. 88A. The villa is not that far from Atlas Superclub, making it perfect for tourists to have close accommodation from the Bali night club. Also, you can visit several beach clubs in Canggu after booking a room in Canggu Circle Villa to spend leisure time.
Conclusion: Ready for the Wildest Night of Your Life?
