title: Best Night Clubs in Canggu: The 2026 Party & Nightlife Guide
content:
Entering 2026, the Canggu nightclub scene has officially become one of biggest nightlife attractions in Bali, filled with a youthful crowd, lively energy, and buzzing social spots. The heart of the party scene is mostly around Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong and Jalan Pantai Berawa, where the atmosphere stays busy and exciting almost every night.
If you’re searching for the best spots to party until late, there are plenty of exciting places worth visiting. Here’s your 2026 guide to the best nightlife and party destinations in Canggu.
Best Night Clubs in Canggu
1. Old Man’s – The OG Canggu Club
No guide to Canggu nightlife 2026 would be complete without Old Man’s, especially their new face post-COVID. Located near Batu Bolong Beach, this legendary venue stays packed every Wednesday with its famous Dirty Wednesdays party and free entry.
The vibe is casual, fun, and budget-friendly, attracting surfers, backpackers, expats, and travelers from everywhere. Expect crowd-favorite music, beer pong games, and a packed dance floor that perfectly shows why Canggu is popular for nightlife and late-night fun.
2. Vault Nightclub Bali
If you’re into late-night clubbing, Vault Canggu is one of the best clubs in Canggu, Bali, for a more underground party experience. The venue feels like a dark industrial bunker with intense lighting, powerful sound systems, and a crowd that comes mainly for the music.
Expect techno, house, tech-house, plus occasional hip-hop and R&B nights. It’s the kind of place where the party goes strong until early morning.
Mesa Bali is one of the go-to spots for Afrobeats, hip-hop, R&B, and dancehall lovers in Canggu. The vibe is modern, trendy, and full of energy, with music that keeps the dance floor busy all night long. The venue itself has a unique three-level setup, starting with a more relaxed dining atmosphere downstairs before turning into a lively rooftop party scene as the night goes on.
The rooftop pool adds to the fun summer-party atmosphere, making it one of the highlights of the Mesa Bali Canggu nightlife experience. Saturdays are usually the busiest nights, with packed crowds and a more intense party vibe that goes late into the night.
Miss Fish Bali brings together stylish dining and nightlife in one place. The atmosphere feels chic, intimate, and premium, starting as an elegant Japanese restaurant before slowly turning into a lively late-night party spot in the Berawa area.
The music mostly focuses on deep house, tech-house, and electronic beats, with regular international DJ performances that keep the energy going throughout the night. What makes Miss Fish Canggu stand out is the experience itself, you can enjoy premium sushi and fresh seafood for dinner, then continue straight into the party without changing venues.
5. Luigi’s Hot Pizza
Mondays in Canggu are all about Metto Mondays at Luigi’s Hot Pizza Canggu. What starts as a casual pizza spot quickly turns into one of the wildest weekly parties in the area.
Expect open-air dancing, energetic electronic music from local DJ collective PNNY, and a super social crowd. If you want to experience the real Canggu party scene, this is one of the most iconic ways to start the week.
Tuesdays at Kitsuné Village bring a more stylish and curated vibe. This trendy lifestyle destination mixes French and Japanese influences with a modern tropical setting that feels elegant but still relaxed for a night out in Canggu.
The crowd is fashionable, the music leans toward house and techno, and the atmosphere around the pool feels more refined than chaotic. For travelers exploring bars in Canggu or searching for more upscale things to do at night, this spot is worth adding to the list.
7. Black Sand Brewery
Fridays at Black Sand Brewery are relaxed, social, and always lively. The open-air garden setting, industrial-style bar, and rice field surroundings create a laid-back atmosphere that’s perfect for starting the weekend.
Local DJs usually play chill house, indie dance, or vinyl sets while people enjoy fresh craft beers on tap. It’s also a great stop if you’re exploring the Batu Bolong nightlife area.
At night, Revolver Bali transforms from a cozy coffee shop into a stylish hidden bar with a speakeasy feel. The vibe is intimate and trendy, with nu-disco, funky house, and easy-to-enjoy remixes filling the room.
Their espresso-based cocktails are especially popular, making this spot a favorite pre-party destination in one of Bali’s most sought-after nightlife spots.
9. Lacalita Bar y Cocina
Saturdays at Lacalita Bar y Cocina are energetic, colorful, and full of fun group vibes. Inspired by lively Mexican culture, this place is known for its upbeat atmosphere, Latin music, reggaeton, and crowd-favorite party hits.
The tacos are a must-try, and their margaritas are famous for being strong and refreshing. Before heading deeper into the Batu Bolong nightlife scene or continuing your Canggu bar hopping route, this is one of the best places to kick off a Saturday night.
Sundays at La Brisa Bali offer one of the most iconic beachfront party experiences in Canggu. Built from reclaimed wood taken from old fishing boats, the venue has a unique tropical atmosphere that feels rustic, artistic, and right by the ocean
During the day, the vibe is more relaxed with local markets and sunset lounging, but at night it transforms into a lively beachfront dance floor. Deep house, melodic techno, and organic electronic music play throughout the night, mixing perfectly with the sound of the waves from Echo Beach.
It’s easy to see why this place is famous for its Sunday parties and why many travelers consider it one of the best spots for a Berawa beach party and late-night beach vibes in Canggu.
11. FINNS Beach Club
FINNS Beach Club is one of the biggest and most famous beachfront party destinations in Bali. Located along Berawa Beach, the venue is known for its massive bamboo structure, tropical atmosphere, and lively beachside energy from day to night.
During the day, people come to relax by the pool and enjoy the ocean view, but once sunset hits, the vibe turns into a huge beachfront party. The music mostly features vocal house, EDM, and tech-house played by resident DJs, live vocalists, and international guest DJs.
What makes FINNS Beach Club Canggu stand out is the scale of the venue itself, with multiple infinity pools, swim-up bars, and plenty of areas to party or chill. Another reason why it stays popular is the free entry to the standard area and their daily Happy Hour from 8 to 9 PM, making it one of the busiest sunset party spots in Canggu.
What are the best nightclubs in Canggu?
It really depends on the vibe you’re looking for. FINNS Beach Club is perfect for huge beachfront parties, Vault Nightclub Bali is the go-to for underground techno lovers, and Luigi’s Hot Pizza is famous for its wild Monday night parties with the PNNY crowd.
Is Canggu nightlife good?
Yes, definitely. Canggu has become one of the top nightlife destinations in Bali, known for its energetic atmosphere, variety of venues, and social crowd. From beach clubs and rooftop bars to underground clubs and live music spots, there’s always something happening almost every night.
What time do clubs close in Canggu?
Most beach bars and beach clubs, including places like Old Man’s and FINNS Beach Club, usually close around midnight or 1 AM. Meanwhile, indoor clubs like Vault Nightclub Bali often keep the party going until 3 to 5 AM.
Is there a dress code?
Most places in Canggu have a relaxed beachwear or casual style, so the dress code is generally pretty easygoing. However, some indoor clubs and VIP areas, such as Vault Nightclub Bali or Miss Fish Bali, may not allow flip-flops, singlets, or sports shorts for male guests. Casual shirts and proper footwear are usually the safest choice for a night out.
Get Ready to Party in Bali’s Nightclubs
If you want to experience the best of the nightclub Canggu scene in one night, start with sunset cocktails at FINNS Beach Club or La Brisa Bali, where you can enjoy ocean views, music, and a lively beach atmosphere before the crowds get bigger. Continue the night with dinner at Miss Fish Bali for a more stylish and upscale vibe, or head to Lacalita Bar y Cocina if you prefer a fun and energetic dinner with cocktails and group vibes.
After dinner, choose your party route based on the atmosphere you want. For underground techno and late-night clubbing, head straight to Vault Nightclub Bali, while travelers looking for a more social and casual party usually continue to Old Man’s or Mesa Bali. This kind of sunset-to-club experience is exactly why the night club Canggu scene keeps attracting party lovers from all around the world.

title: We Tried Norii Ubud for Japanese-Style All-Day Dining: Here’s the Real Review
content:
Norii Ubud sits right in the heart of Ubud, an area known for its calm rhythm and laid-back lifestyle, perfect for travelers who want to slow down and unwind. While Ubud feels peaceful, its food scene is anything but boring, with diverse dining concepts, including Norii Japanese Restaurant on Jl. Sawah Indah, Gang Amarea No. 8, Peliatan.
In this article, we’ll share our honest experience dining at Norii Ubud. From the atmosphere to the food, here’s our real review after trying their all-day Japanese-style dining.
When We Visited and What Time Works Best
As an all-day dining spot, Norii Ubud gives you the freedom to visit anytime without worrying about strict meal hours. Still, timing matters if you want the experience to match your mood.
Mornings at Norii tend to be quiet and unhurried, making the space feel calm and intimate. As lunchtime approaches, guests slowly fill the restaurant until late lunch, then it eases again in the early evening before picking up during the main dinner rush.
If you’re wondering what to do in Ubud and prefer a peaceful dining moment, come around 10–11 AM or early dinner between 5–6 PM. For a more energetic vibe, lunch hours from 12–2 PM and dinner time around 7–9 PM are when the restaurant feels most alive.
Seating at Norii Ubud keeps things cozy rather than over-the-top, which works beautifully for long, relaxed meals. With comfy sofas and a yakitori bar area, this Japanese restaurant in Ubud, Bali feels welcoming and casual, even suitable for working or lingering. Just keep in mind that during peak hours, it can feel a bit less comfortable as the space gets busier.
Thanks to its large windows, the restaurant feels calm and slightly muted during the day, while evenings bring in warmer, dimmer lighting for a more dramatic, intimate mood.
If you’re aiming for content-worthy shots, grab a corner seat near the window, this spot has the best natural light and a lush, tropical backdrop that easily earns its place among the best restaurants in Ubud.
Norii Ubud keeps things refreshingly simple by serving one all-day menu, so you’re never limited by breakfast, lunch, or dinner hours.
Whatever time you drop by, the Norii Ubud menu always has something that fits the mood, making it an easy stop while deciding on other things to do in Ubud.
In the morning, you won’t find acai bowls, but there are satisfying sandwiches and light salads, paired with a solid drink lineup of smoothies, coffee, and tea. Lunch leans more filling, with comforting ramen, fried rice, plus a good range of sushi and sashimi.
Come dinner, the menu feels more complete with appetizers, mains, and desserts, complemented by signature cocktails, wines, and premium spirits, perfect for winding down after a day exploring Ubud.
This first course features the savory umami flavor of grilled shiitake mushrooms combined with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce. The addition of katsuobushi and scallions provides a distinctive smoky aroma and freshness.
The portion consists of two thick mushroom skewers, serving as a perfect appetizer to whet your appetite. The dish offers great value through its artistic presentation and use of premium ingredients. Served as two thick, satisfying skewers, it’s a light yet flavorful starter that sets the tone for the meal.
With its elegant presentation and quality ingredients, this appetizer feels right at home alongside the dining standards you’d expect near luxury hotels in Ubud.
Pork Skewers (Yakitori)
A crowd-pleaser at what many consider the best Japanese restaurant Ubud has to offer, these pork skewers are juicy, smoky, and deeply satisfying. The grilled pork is coated in a rich Korean BBQ sauce, finished with a gentle kick of togarashi, and lifted by the nutty aroma of sesame seeds and fresh scallions.
Served on two hearty skewers, it’s filling enough to enjoy as a premium snack or a side dish. While it sits on the higher end of the price range, the quality of the meat and the beautifully crafted yakitori make it worth it for true Japanese grill lovers.
A generous 200 grams of tender wagyu striploin is grilled using traditional robatayaki techniques, bringing out a rich, smoky depth in every bite. This dish is all about letting quality speak for itself.
Served with savory yakiniku sauce, charred seasonal vegetables, crispy garlic chips, spring onions, and a subtle touch of ichimi chili, it’s bold yet perfectly balanced. Hearty, comforting, and undeniably satisfying, this is the kind of main course that makes the splurge feel absolutely worth it.
This comforting bowl of yaki ramen brings big flavors and serious satisfaction. Chewy stir-fried noodles are tossed with salmon and shrimp, mixed with fresh vegetables, and finished with katsuo flakes and nori for an extra layer of umami.
Rich, savory, and filling, it’s a well-balanced main course that feels generous and rewarding, especially with premium seafood packed into one delicious plate.
Green Tea Brûlée (Dessert)
A sweet and refreshing finish on the Norii Ubud menu, this dessert pairs creamy vanilla ice cream with rich matcha green tea ice cream, served in a crisp cone for a satisfying crunch.
Light, smooth, and not overly sweet, it’s perfect for cleansing the palate after a savory meal. Presented on a minimalist wooden stand, this dessert feels thoughtfully crafted and effortlessly Instagrammable, simple, elegant, and memorable.
At Norii Ubud, the Shochu Highball is a light, refreshing drink that’s easy to enjoy at any time of day. Crisp, clean, and gently fizzy, it highlights the smooth character of shochu without feeling heavy.
Served simply and elegantly, it’s the kind of drink that pairs well with Japanese dishes and keeps the experience relaxed and effortless.
If you’re after something light, fresh, and nourishing, this is one of the best picks on the menu. Norii’s Poke Bowl is packed with crisp vegetables like edamame, cucumber, red radish, and avocado, bringing plenty of fiber and natural goodness to the bowl.
Instead of heavy meat, it uses teriyaki tofu for a gentle, satisfying protein boost, paired with sweet potato teriyaki that adds a comforting sweet-savory touch. The result is a dish that’s full of umami flavor, yet easy on the stomach and perfect for a feel-good meal.
Chicken Teriyaki Don
When a craving for something hearty strikes, look no further than the Chicken Teriyaki Don, it’s a reliable favorite. Juicy grilled chicken leg is glazed in a rich, sweet-savory teriyaki sauce that feels instantly comforting.
Once you break the onsen egg and let it melt into the warm rice, every bite turns creamy, cozy, and deeply satisfying, exactly the kind of dish that hits the spot.
Gather your friends for the sushi selection, ideal for sharing, especially the Aburi Salmon Roll. Each piece brings a satisfying mix of textures, with lightly torched salmon on the outside and a hearty filling of kani kama, crunchy kyuri, sweet tamago, sansoku, and a touch of shredded tuna on top.
Served in eight generous pieces lined up neatly, it’s easy to grab one (or two) while still leaving room to try other dishes at the table.
The Sashimi Set is a beautiful choice for a calm, mindful meal during your quiet time in Ubud. Featuring fresh cuts of salmon, tuna, and ebi, it highlights the pure taste and delicate texture of quality seafood without distraction.
Paired simply with wasabi, pickled ginger, and soy sauce, it feels light, clean, and satisfying, perfect when you want something nourishing that lets you slow down and enjoy the moment.
Drinks and Sweet Things
If you’re in the mood for something fun, playful, and a little unexpected, the Bubble Gum Club is a must-try signature cocktail. Gin and fresh raspberry purée bring a bright, fruity base, while bubble gum syrup adds a nostalgic sweetness that instantly lifts the mood.
A squeeze of lemon keeps it fresh and balanced, and a few drops of Angostura bitters give it a subtle, grown-up twist. The result is a cheerful, sweet, and refreshingly easy drink to enjoy.
Tropical Orange is a great mocktail choice when you want something refreshing and alcohol-free, especially after exploring a waterfall in Ubud. It brings together bright citrus flavors from grapefruit syrup, pomelo pulp, strawberries, and fresh orange juice, creating a sweet-and-tangy burst in every sip.
Finished with sparkling tonic water and a light layer of ginger foam, this drink feels fresh, playful, and gently warming, perfect for cooling down while still feeling a little special.
End your meal on a sweet note with the Chocolate Lava Cake, a comforting classic done right. The cake is soft on the outside with warm, melted chocolate flowing from the center, delivering a rich and indulgent bite every time.
Fresh fruit salsa adds a light, sweet-and-tangy contrast, while a scoop of vanilla ice cream keeps everything smooth and balanced. It’s the kind of dessert you’ll be happy to find at a Japanese restaurant in Ubud that knows how to finish a dining experience beautifully.
If you’re just ordering one main dish and a drink, expect to spend around IDR 200,000+. But if you’re in the mood to explore the menu, it’s safer to budget around IDR 500,000 per person.
For the best value, go for a light appetizer paired with a main course and a cocktail or mocktail. You’ll still feel full and satisfied without overspending. If you’re watching your budget, it’s best to skip the steak and focus on the authentic Japanese dishes instead, they offer a more memorable, restaurant-style experience for the price.
The food comes out at a comfortable pace, not rushed, but not leaving you waiting too long either. It gives you enough time to relax and chat with friends, with dishes arriving in the order you place them. Drinks usually come first, and the wait for the first dish is around 10–15 minutes, depending on how busy the restaurant is.
What really stands out is the staff. They’re friendly, attentive, and happy to walk you through the menu if you’re unsure what to choose. They’ll also check for allergies in advance, which makes the whole dining experience feel thoughtful and well taken care of.Practical Info
Since the resort sits at the end of a small alley, the road leading to it is quite narrow. If two cars meet from opposite directions, you’ll need to slow down and carefully pass each other. Once you reach the end of the lane, the resort opens up nicely.
Parking is available and fits around three cars and several motorbikes, so it’s sufficient without feeling crowded. If you’re traveling solo, getting there by motorcycle is the easiest and most convenient option.
If you’re visiting with a group, it’s best to make a reservation so the team can arrange the most comfortable seating for you. Coming solo or with a partner? Walk-ins are usually fine, though booking ahead is still a good idea if you’re planning a more intimate fine-dining moment.
To enjoy a quieter atmosphere without reservations, try coming between meal times, just before lunch or early evening, when the restaurant is in its calm transition phase.
Norii is a great pick if you love food that’s hearty, satisfying, and comforting, with a few creative twists along the way. The best time to visit is in the late afternoon, between lunch and dinner, when the space feels relaxed, and you can catch soft sunset light streaming through the large windows and open-air setting.
Overall, Norii earns a solid 4.5-star rating. The food scores 4.5 stars, mainly because vegan, vegetarian, and kids’ options are still limited. The atmosphere is a standout with a full 5 stars, warm, cozy, and rich with natural wood details, while value also gets 5 stars, thanks to generous portions at reasonable prices.
1. Is it good for working?
It really depends on when you visit. The atmosphere is nice and comfortable, but during busy and peak hours, it can get quite lively, so it’s not the most ideal spot if you’re planning to work or stay focused for long.
2. What is best for lunch?
If you’re stopping by for a satisfying lunch, Norii’s steak, rice dishes, and dry ramen are solid picks that really hit the spot. Their sushi is also worth ordering, especially if you want something lighter but still flavorful.
3. Is it authentic or Japanese-inspired
Yes, the menu is deeply rooted in authentic Japanese cuisine, from sushi and sashimi to dry ramen, yakitori, and comforting rice dishes. Everything is given a modern touch, even the steaks, which are seasoned with rich, flavorful yakiniku for a uniquely Japanese-inspired finish.
4. Do they have vegetarian options?
There are vegetarian options available, but most of the Japanese-inspired main courses are still meat-focused. If you’re vegetarian, the good news is that Norii also serves Indian specialties, and those come with a dedicated vegetarian section that offers more variety and satisfying choices.
Ordering at Norii feels simple and familiar, just like dining at any casual restaurant. You pick a table, browse the menu at your own pace, and once you’re ready, the staff will come over to take your order and confirm everything before sending it to the kitchen.

title: Paed Thai Sanur, Our Honest Review for Thai Food Dinner
content:
Paed Thai Sanur sits in a very different rhythm compared to the lively scenes of Canggu and Seminyak. Located in one of Bali’s oldest and most relaxed coastal areas, Sanur is known for its calm, family-friendly vibe, making it the perfect setting for a comforting and flavorful dining experience.
In this article, we’ll take you through an honest and detailed look at Paed Thai Sanur, from its atmosphere to the flavors on the plate. Here is Paed Thai Sanur, our honest review of Thai Food Dinner.
Location and First Impressions Paed Thai Sanur
Located on Jalan Bypass Ngurah Rai No. 888A, Paed Thai Sanur is easy to spot thanks to its position right on the main road and a bold sign you can see from afar. Getting here is hassle-free, with a spacious parking area that comfortably fits several cars and plenty of motorcycles, making it a convenient restaurant in Sanur to visit anytime.
From the outside, the building immediately catches your eye with its modern tropical design. Step inside and you’ll be welcomed warmly by the staff, setting the tone for a relaxed dining experience.
The interior blends modern luxury with subtle traditional elements, industrial grey walls paired with rich wooden furniture, gold-toned geometric chandeliers, and Thai-inspired artworks that quietly reflect the soul of Paed Thai cuisine restaurants in Bali are known for.
Once seated, drinks arrive first, followed by your dishes in a well-paced flow. The team will even check when you’d like your dessert served, a small detail that adds to the comfort.
Expect around 15 to 30 minutes for the full spread to reach the table, giving you just enough time to browse the Paed Thai Sanur menu and soak in the calm, welcoming atmosphere.
Atmosphere and Seating Guide at Paed Thai Sanur
The indoor dining space at Paed Thai Sanur by Wonderspace feels instantly inviting, elegant yet relaxed. Soft, warm lighting from the signature gold geometric chandeliers creates an intimate mood, while natural wood tables and chairs add a cozy, home-like touch that many guests often mention.
Step outside and the vibe shifts to something more laid-back and refreshing. Surrounded by lush greenery and tropical plants, the outdoor area feels calm and breezy, a pleasant surprise considering the restaurant sits along a main road.
It’s a great spot for those who enjoy natural light and relaxed conversations, especially for guests who love capturing aesthetic Paed Thai Sanur photos.
Seating is thoughtfully arranged for different occasions. Long communal tables work perfectly for group dinners or celebrations, while cozy corner tables near the windows are ideal for a more romantic setting. These spots offer soft lighting and a bit more privacy, making them far more comfortable than seating near the cashier or high-traffic areas.
Music plays a subtle but important role in the experience. During the day, the playlist is light and upbeat, while evenings bring slower, mood-setting tunes.
The volume stays just right, enough to enhance the atmosphere without overpowering conversation, making this restaurant an easy addition to your list of things to do in Sanur for a relaxed yet memorable night out.
Menu Overview and What It’s Known For
One thing that really stands out in Paed Thai Sanur reviews is how complete and comforting the menu feels. You’ll find familiar favorites like Tom Yum alongside classic Thai street food such as Tod Mun Pla, making Paed Sanur a great place if you want to explore a wide range of Thai flavors in one sitting.
The food leans strongly toward comfort food territory, rich, satisfying, and perfect for sharing. Portions are generous, especially dishes like Pla Krapong Neung Manao, a beautifully steamed garoupa available in 300g or 500g sizes, ideal for enjoying together at the table. It’s the kind of meal that feels filling without being overwhelming.
When it comes to spice, the kitchen strikes a thoughtful balance. You’re free to choose your preferred heat level, so both spice lovers and cautious eaters are well accommodated. All dishes still use authentic Thai spices, and the presence of a dedicated kids’ menu makes dining here easy for families with young children who aren’t ready for chili-heavy dishes yet.
Price-wise, Paed Sanur sits slightly on the higher end for Sanur, but the quality, portion size, and overall experience make it feel fair. If the service leaves a good impression, a small tipping gesture is always appreciated and fits naturally with the relaxed, friendly atmosphere of the restaurant.
At first glance, it might look like thick-cut calamari, but this is actually a classic Thai street food favorite: prawn cake served with som tam salad and a Thai dipping sauce. Take one bite, and you’ll notice the contrast right away, crispy on the outside, soft and slightly dense on the inside.
The flavor is nicely balanced, savory without being overpowering, with the taste of fresh shrimp still coming through in a subtle way. What really elevates the dish is the sweet-and-sour Thai sauce, which adds a gentle kick without too much heat.
Paired with the crunchy, tangy som tam salad, every bite becomes a fun mix of textures and flavors that keeps you going back for more.
Tom Yum Hot Pot Creamy
This main course comes with an unexpected but delightful twist with the addition of creamy evaporated milk. The result is a dish that feels comforting and rich, with a bold spice kick that warms you up without overwhelming the palate.
You can still clearly taste the fragrant lemongrass, which blends beautifully with the seafood. Fresh green mussels and plump, juicy shrimp soak up the flavorful broth, creating a satisfying balance of creamy, spicy, and aromatic notes in every spoonful.
Pineapple Friend Rice
This dish feels just like the classic pineapple fried rice you’d expect at a Thai restaurant, but with a little extra punch. The seasoning is bolder, thanks to the use of Thai spices and a confident splash of fish sauce that brings out a deep, savory flavor.
The natural sweetness and freshness of the pineapple cut through the richness beautifully, creating a balance that’s both comforting and exciting. It’s fragrant, satisfying, and generously portioned, making it an easy choice if you’re looking for a filling meal that still feels light and enjoyable.
Jackfruit Creme Brulee
This dessert feels like a sweet little surprise, thanks to the addition of tropical jackfruit that brings a naturally fruity sweetness. The texture is soft and comforting, with a lightly torched sugar topping that adds a gentle caramelized crunch.
It’s the kind of dessert that closes a meal perfectly, not too heavy, just sweet enough, and especially satisfying after a series of bold, savory, and spicy dishes.
No Thai meal feels truly complete without a glass of Thai tea. It strikes a lovely balance, creamy but not overly sweet, with that gentle, slightly bitter tea note still shining through.
If you want to play it safe on your first visit, the best-selling Pad Thai Goong is always a great choice. The rice noodles are wok-tossed with juicy prawns, crunchy bean sprouts, peanuts, fish sauce, and a squeeze of lime, delivering that classic balance of savory, gentle sweetness, and a bright, refreshing tang.
Feeling a bit more adventurous? Go for the Pork Corral, featuring perfectly seared pork paired with a bold red Thai sauce, pineapple, and lychee relish. The pork stays wonderfully juicy, while the sauce brings a spicy kick that’s beautifully balanced with sweet and sour notes.
For something to share, the Pork Belly Kailan is a comforting side, with stir-fried greens, tender pork belly, and crispy garlic. And to end on a high note, the Mango Sticky Rice is a must, served the authentic way with ripe mango and rich coconut milk, the perfect sweet finish to your meal.
When it comes to drinks, the selection is just as fun as the food. They serve everything from cocktails and mocktails to fresh juices and teas, so there’s something for every mood.
If you’re pairing your drink with rich, savory dishes, the Whiskey Thai Tea is a standout. It blends the sweetness of condensed milk with a gentle bitterness, creating a smooth, comforting sip that works surprisingly well with bold flavors.
For something lighter and more refreshing, Sawadee Kab is a great choice, with bright lemon notes and a hint of basil that feels crisp and uplifting. If you prefer non-alcoholic options, the Canggu Sunset mocktail is sweet, refreshing, and especially satisfying after a spicy tom yum.
While the tea menu is quite extensive, the authentic Thai tea easily steals the spotlight and is a must-try to complete the experience.
At first glance, Paed Thai Sanur may feel a little on the pricier side, but once the food arrives, it quickly makes sense. With generous portions and bold, satisfying flavors, the value really shows.
On average, you can expect to spend around IDR 200,000 to IDR 400,000 per person, depending on how adventurous you are with the menu.
The best part is that many dishes are perfect for sharing, so dining with friends or family makes it even more worthwhile. When you split a few plates and try different flavors, the experience feels both indulgent and surprisingly good value.
Service and Dining Pace
The service here truly stands out and feels genuinely thoughtful. From the moment you arrive, the team takes great care of you, asking about your seating preference and the number of guests so they can find the most comfortable table for your visit.
The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and happy to walk you through the menu, even giving helpful tips on spice levels or warning you if a dish might be too big for one person.
The food arrives at a relaxed, well-timed pace, just right for a mid-range to upscale dining experience. It’s not rushed, yet never feels slow, which makes sense since everything is prepared fresh.
Overall, the service feels attentive without being intrusive, letting you enjoy your meal at ease.
Dietary Notes and Preferences
The menu is thoughtfully laid out with clear icons that show details like pork content, spice level, and other helpful notes, making it easy to choose at a glance. While vegetarian and vegan options aren’t extensive since some salads still use animal-based dressings, the team is open to special requests.
There’s a customizable Thai curry that can be made with vegetables, which works well for plant-based diners. If you have food allergies or dietary preferences, just let the staff know. They’re happy to explain the ingredients and adjust dishes so you can enjoy your meal with peace of mind.
Paed Thai Sanur by The Wonderspace welcomes guests daily from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m., making it an easy choice for anything from a relaxed breakfast to a cozy dinner. Planning to come with a big group? It’s best to reserve ahead so your seating is perfectly arranged, while smaller groups can simply walk in without a fuss.
Payment is hassle-free with options like QRIS, debit cards, and cash. Plus, the spacious parking area right in front of the restaurant means you won’t have to stress about finding a spot when you arrive.
This spot is a dream for spice lovers who enjoy bold flavors and a bit of heat, but it may not be the best fit if you prefer mild dishes. Most of the dishes are meat-focused, so vegetarian and vegan choices are quite limited.
The best time to come is for lunch or dinner, when the generous portions really shine and leave you feeling satisfied. On rainy days, the comforting, warming dishes feel even more enjoyable.
Overall, it scores a solid 4.5/5: 4.5 for the food, a perfect 5 for the vibe, and 4.5 for value, making it a place we’d happily return to.
Do I need a reservation?
It really depends on your plan. If you’re coming with a big group or hoping for a romantic dinner, it’s best to reserve in advance so you can get a comfortable table. For casual meals or smaller groups, walk-ins are usually fine since the space is quite roomy.
Is the food very spicy?
By Southeast Asian standards, the spice level is quite manageable. That said, if you’re sensitive to heat, some dishes may feel a bit intense. The good news is that the staff are happy to adjust the spiciness to your preference.
Best dishes for first-timers
If this is your first Thai food experience, Pad Thai Goong is a safe and delicious choice with its savory-sweet balance and no heavy heat. If you’re feeling adventurous and want something more authentic, the tom yum is a must-try.
Expect to spend around IDR 200,000–400,000 per person, depending on how many dishes you order. Portions are generous and perfect for sharing, which makes the experience feel more worthwhile.
Yes, very. Paed Thai Sanur offers a kids’ menu and baby chairs, making it a comfortable option for families dining with little ones.

title: 6 Pantai di Area Canggu yang Terkenal untuk Surfing
content:
Canggu dikenal sebagai kawasan dengan perpaduan unik antara nuansa lokal yang santai, dan atmosfer pesisir yang identik dengan dunia surfing. Selama berselancar di area ini, penting untuk memperhatikan jenis pantai, karena ombak di setiap pesisir berbeda, yang akan mempengaruhi tingkat kesulitan atau kelas ombak tersebut.
Melalui artikel ini, kamu akan menemukan panduan lengkap tentang pantai-pantai di kawasan barat Bali. Berikut 6 pantai di area Canggu yang paling populer dan menjadi favorit para peselancar.
6 Pantai di Area Canggu yang Cocok untuk Surfing
Sebagai salah satu pantai daerah Canggu paling populer, Pantai Berawa menawarkan area yang luas dengan beberapa titik pecah ombak, sehingga suasananya terasa lebih lega meski ramai.
Ombaknya cenderung lebih kuat dan cepat dibandingkan area pesisir lainnya, cocok untuk peselancar level menengah yang ingin naik level dari longboard ke papan lebih pendek.
Lokasinya berdekatan dengan berbagai beach club di Canggu menjadikan Berawa pilihan pas untuk selancar sore, lalu lanjut menikmati musik, sunset, dan suasana santai.
2. Pantai Batu Bolong
Pantai Batu Bolong bisa dibilang sebagai pusat kehidupan selancar di pantai Canggu di Bali. Berada di ujung Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong, pesisir ini dikenal dengan ombaknya yang ramah pemula, tebal, cenderung lambat, dan panjang. Sehingga memberi waktu lebih bagi peselancar untuk berdiri dengan stabil.
Karakter ombak di sini membuatnya sangat digemari pengguna longboard. Suasananya selalu hidup, dikelilingi sekolah selancar, penyewaan papan, serta kafe dan spot nongkrong yang menjadikannya salah satu area untuk beraktivitas di Canggu.
Terletak di antara Berawa dan Batu Bolong, Pantai Nelayan dikenal sebagai salah satu pantai di Canggu yang bagus untuk suasana santai dan belajar selancar. Deretan perahu nelayan tradisional masih terlihat di pesisirnya, memberi nuansa autentik dan jarang ditemui di spot lain.
Ombaknya relatif tenang dan stabil, sangat ideal untuk pemula yang ingin berlatih berdiri di papan tanpa tekanan keramaian. Dengan dasar pantai berpasir, area ini terasa lebih aman saat terjatuh, sekaligus cocok untuk aktivitas bersama anak di Canggu yang ingin bermain air atau pasir dalam suasana tenang.
4. Pantai Batu Mejan (Echo Beach)
Echo Beach adalah ikon selancar Canggu yang terkenal dengan kekuatan ombak cepat, dan menantang, favorit para peselancar berpengalaman. Terdapat kombinasi reef dan sand break,membuat spot ini dinamis dan tidak direkomendasikan bagi pemula.
Meski begitu, pesisir ini sangat populer untuk menikmati pantai Canggu dan sunsetnya yang magis. Terdapat pilihan restoran di tepi pesisirnya yang menyajikan BBQ dan suasana senja ikonik. Lokasi ini juga mudah dijangkau apabila kamu dari Seminyak ke Canggu. Hal ini yang menjadikannya pilihan pas untuk menutup hari dengan pemandangan matahari terbenam.
Berada di sisi barat Echo Beach, Pantai Pererenan dikenal lebih tenang dan terasa eksklusif dibandingkan pusat keramaian Pantai Canggu yang viral. Ombak kanannya tajam dan bertenaga, menjadikannya sebagai favorit peselancar level menengah hingga profesional.
Karakter ombak di Echo beach yang konsisten sepanjang tahun sering jadi alternatif saat spot lain padat. Sementara kombinasi dasar pantainya membentuk gelombang rapi dan teknis.
Suasananya lebih damai, berlatar sawah masih terjaga, pas untuk menikmati senja tanpa hiruk-pikuk. Kawasan di sini juga dipenuhi dengan beragam restoran terkenal sehingga cocok didatangi bersama keluarga.
Istilah lain Pantai Canggu kerap merujuk area sekitar Batu Bolong, tetapi keduanya berbeda karena Batu Bolong adalah pusat keramaian selancar, sedangkan Pantai Canggu lebih tenang dengan perahu nelayannya.
Di sini, variasi ombak cocok untuk semua level, ada yang ramah pemula, ada pula yang menantang saat swell besar datang. Penyewaan papan dan instruktur berjajar di tepi pesisr, membuat siapa pun mudah mencoba selancar
Untuk tiket masuk ke Pantai Canggu umumnya gratis, jadi aksesnya makin praktis. Menjelang senja, area ini hidup dengan siluet kafe ikonik, dan pesta di area ini yang berlangsung hanya beberapa langkah dari pasir.
Rekomendasi Akomodasi Mewah yang Ramah di Kantong Dekat Pantai Canggu
Pantai Canggu menawarkan spektrum pengalaman yang lengkap, mulai dari ombak ramah pemula hingga spot menantang untuk peselancar berpengalaman, berpadu dengan gaya hidup pesisir yang kreatif dan dinamis. Dari pagi yang aktif hingga senja yang meriah, kawasan ini selalu punya alasan untuk dikunjungi kembali.
Jika kamu ingin tinggal dekat dengan semua energi itu, Ini Vie Hospitality menghadirkan pilihan akomodasi terbaik di Bali yang strategis dekat pantai-pantai Canggu. Jadikan liburanmu lebih praktis dan berkelas, pesan penginapanmu sekarang dan nikmati Canggu dari jarak terbaik.

title: 7 Pilates Studios in Canggu for Wellness Routine
content:
Pilates has become one of the most popular exercises in Canggu, attracting locals, expats, and tourists who want to maintain their fitness routines with affordable pricing and tips in Bali. Finding the right place for Reformer or Mat sessions is essential to maximise your results, whether you are a beginner or an advanced practitioner.
This guide will help you explore the best options, from group classes to specialised Private Pilates Canggu sessions. Here is the complete list of recommended Pilates in Canggu, Bali.
Pilates Studios in Canggu
Canggu has evolved into one of the top wellness destinations in Bali, which is why Pilates is growing rapidly in this vibrant coastal town. Below are the highly recommended studios, each offering unique atmospheres and specialised programs.
1. Native Tree Pilates Canggu
Located on Jalan Nelayan, Native Tree is known for its calm and aesthetic studio setting that supports a holistic training experience. The studio offers various Reformer classes suitable for all levels and personalised private Pilates sessions in Canggu.
Native Tree is often praised for its attentive instructors who consistently correct posture and ensure proper alignment. The well-maintained studio, complete facilities, and positive, professional team make it a favourite among those seeking a studio with a strong foundation approach.
It is also easy to book your session, and every time you visit this place, you will be welcomed by friendly front office staff.
2. Ritual Pilates Studio
As the name suggests, every session here feels like a ritual, calming, engaging, and energising. Ritual offers Reformer classes for both beginners and advanced practitioners.
The bright and beautifully designed studio creates an ideal environment for focused training with great hospitality. Signature classes include Daily Ritual (full body), Strength Ritual (glutes and lower body), and Balance Ritual (flexibility).
The instructors are energetic and supportive, and the twinkling ceiling lights create a dreamy workout ambience, making it a perfect choice for those seeking a unique pilates experience in Canggu, Bali.
3. A Plus Pilates Canggu
A Plus Pilates is known for its high-energy and diverse class offerings, including Reformer, Mat, and Barre. The spacious studio features an aesthetic, bright interior that instantly feels welcoming.
It also offers a convenient location between Canggu and Seminyak, close to Kayu Putih Beach and surrounded by many hotel near beach options. With a capacity of eight people, the classes feel intimate and comfortable, perfect for beginners who prefer clear and supportive guidance.
This studio is perfect for anyone wanting challenging workouts, especially the Sweatformer and Strongformer sessions. It is one of the best options for dynamic pilates training in Canggu.
This studio offers both Reformer and Mat Pilates for beginners and advanced practitioners. They also provide pre- and postnatal Reformer classes designed to support the body during pregnancy and postpartum recovery, focusing on core and pelvic floor strength safely.
Instructors give proper form corrections, ensuring correct muscle engagement. The studio also features a café downstairs offering healthy menus like salads and protein smoothies with great F&B service, making it a complete wellness stop among studios in Canggu.
With multiple locations in Bali, including Pererenan and Berawa, this is one of the most popular studios in Canggu. Classes here combine fitness with Bali’s natural beauty, offering a serene backdrop for both Mat and Reformer sessions.
Their programs include private classes, couples sessions, Rehabilitation classes, and Prenatal & Postnatal training. The scenic environment and being surrounded by popular restaurants in Canggu add a layer of mindfulness and relaxation to every movement, especially during sunset classes.
Maja is a versatile studio offering Pilates, Barre, and Yoga, creating an inviting community space. The studio provides various class schedules and tailored private sessions to help you reach your personal fitness goals.
Maja also includes a spa area perfect for releasing tension after a workout. The on-site café offers specialty matcha drinks and coffee, making it a lovely place to unwind after class.
Pulse is well-known for its dynamic reformer classes that focus on calorie burning and stabilising muscle activation. The studio offers a range of sessions, from slow-burning Pulse classes to heavier Strong classes.
The neutral interior, wide mirrors, and well-maintained equipment create a calming and comfortable environment. Instructors are attentive and ensure participants achieve optimal form, allowing you to feel stronger after every session, making it a great option for intense and results-driven pilates in Canggu practice.
Benefits of Pilates for the Body
According to the Cleveland Clinic, Pilates offers a wide range of physical and mental benefits. For you who want to try pilates, these are the key advantages you can expect.
1. Relieving Pain and Injury Recovery
It is well known for its effectiveness in reducing lower back pain through alignment correction and improved core strength. It is also widely used for injury prevention, chronic musculoskeletal therapy, and speeding up recovery by strengthening the body’s foundational support system.
2. Improving Core Strength
One of the main focuses of these exercises is core development, targeting the abdomen, sides, lower back, buttocks, and hips. Stronger core muscles support overall movement, stability, and daily body functions.
3. Improving Posture
By strengthening and aligning the core, it naturally improves posture. Better posture reduces lower back strain and contributes positively to breathing, digestion, and overall body mechanics.
4. Enhancing Flexibility and Mobility
Pilates involves many controlled stretches that increase flexibility, improve range of motion, and help muscles stay relaxed. This makes the body more mobile and supports healthy movement as you age.
5. Enhancing Balance, Coordination, and Spatial Awareness
A stronger core improves balance and coordination by helping the body maintain its center of gravity. This reduces the risk of falls and enhances the efficiency of everyday movements.
6. Increasing Body Awareness
It requires focus on breathing and controlled movement, helping you develop better body awareness, such as understanding where tension builds or which muscles compensate for weaker areas.
7. Breath Control and Stress Reduction
Breathwork is central to Pilates. Conscious breathing enhances performance and has been shown to reduce stress, promote relaxation, and support emotional regulation.
8. Improving Mental Health and Well-being
Though not a high-intensity workout, this activity combines strength, resistance, and stretching in a way that elevates mood and complements ongoing mental health support.
Final Thoughts on Pilates in Canggu
Incorporating this activity into your holiday is the perfect way to combine relaxation and wellness. With many high-quality pilates in Canggu studios available, from dynamic group classes to tailored Private Pilates Canggu programs, you will easily find a studio that suits your goals.
If you’re looking for the best accommodation after a refreshing session at one of the best Pilates Canggu studios, Ini Vie Hospitality provides luxurious yet affordable stays around the Canggu area, ensuring comfort, a great location, and easy access to wellness activities.

title: 20 Best Restaurants in Canggu: The 2026 Guide
content:
As one of the most vibrant culinary destinations in Southeast Asia, restaurants in Canggu continue to attract food enthusiasts from all over the world. It is easy to discover some of the best restaurants in Canggu offering a rich blend of global flavors, thoughtfully designed interiors, beachfront atmospheres, and creative dishes that reflect Bali and welcome everyone with diet restriction and food preferences.
From dining venues with ocean views to stylish and romantic culinary experiences, Canggu restaurants cater to every type of food preference and occasion. This curated list showcases twenty highly recommended dining spots for those seeking the best restaurants in Canggu for dinner, ambiance, international cuisine, and unforgettable experiences.
Best Restaurants in Canggu with a View
For those who enjoy delicious meals paired with stunning scenery, these are the best restaurants in Canggu with a view that should be on every itinerary. Most of these restaurants are using Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) as their main currency, so this article will provide price information based on that.
Perched right on Canggu Beach, the edgy industrial design with its ocean views becomes a magnet for those seeking sunset dining experiences. The sleek interiors and warm lighting meet the hypnotic rhythm of waves crashing, creating one-of-a-kind dining experiences.
It specializes in grilled food menus that cook in a fire-powered kitchen using primal techniques. This brings a smoky depth that defines every dish in this restaurant and easily becomes their uniqueness.
Try their favorite menus like: Bone Marrow on Toast, potato gratin, and Gnocchi with Truffle, made from fresh and high quality ingredients.
Price range: Typically around IDR 200,000 – IDR 400,000, depending on what you order.
You will be surprised by their unique architecture since the restaurant is set inside a reconstructed 311-year-old Chinese temple. Ji also features an ocean-facing terrace with antique wood and soft lanterns, creating a fusion of East Asian elegance meets Balinese soul.
They are known for the sushi artistry combined with Asian flair, all served in a space that feels timeless and serene. The most highlighted menus are Dragon of Ji sushi roll, Black Cod Miso, and the Wagyu Tataki, perfect pair with a handcrafted sake cocktail while enjoying rooftop sunset views.
Price range: Around IDR 120,000 – IDR 400,000, quite affordable for the upscale dining experience and refined food.
3. Times Beach Warung
Beachfront dining doesn’t mean it should be formal, elegant, and strict. You can also experience the casual beachfront dining in Times Beach Warung, which is perfect for gatherings or hanging out with friends. This restaurant has unique bamboo interiors, boho beanbags, and fairy lights that glow during golden hour.
The laid-back vibes create a casual yet cozy dining experience that is perfect for catching sunsets with friends. The local warung energy blends seamlessly with the beach club feel, making every guest not want to leave.
Try their most favorite menu: fish tacos, fish burger, and fish & chips made from fresh and locally sourced seafood, making it the most relaxing beanbag lounge by the waves. If you want to catch the Sunday Market event earlier, this place will be perfect to grab a breakfast before.
Price range: IDR150,000 – IDR250,000 per person.
Located near the Berawa Beach and Finns Beach Club, Lemon & Salt is the perfect place to enjoy sunset before a party night. This is the one of restaurants in Canggu has wooden finishes that perfectly combine with warm Mediterranean charm.
The breezy terrace seating is my most favorite spot. It features an infinity pool and poolside lounge that create dreamy vibes in the heart of Canggu.
It serves an array of local and international food such as Salmon Teriyaki, Pork Belly Sambal Matah, Duck Confit, Chicken Pesto Wrap, and many options of cocktails that are beautifully paired.
Price range: Typically IDR 80,000 – IDR 250,000, making it a perfect choice for eating out with your friends or beloved one.
Even though it’s more of a party venue than a dining place, the food is exceptional. Everything is perfectly seasoned and cooked with intention. It has a wide variety of food from bold Mexican spices to delicate Japanese dishes. Its commitment is to bring hearty food that can cater to everyone’s palates.
Located within the FINNS Beach Club, the distinguished name of the beach club in Canggu, this restaurant offers a vibrant venue with a pool and sunset glow that elevates your dining experience in the heart of Canggu. Menu highlights include enchiladas, tacos, sushi rolls, smoked salmon pizza, and chicken tandoori.
For those staying in Seminyak, this Canggu restaurant is also reachable. For example, it’s only 25 minutes away from La Mira Villa.
Price: mostly under IDR250,000.
Best Restaurants in Canggu for Romantic Dinner
A romantic dinner should be special, not just the intimate and warm ambiance; the food should be delicious, too. Here are the best restaurants in Canggu for a romantic dinner.
Shichirin offers an intimate place to eat, with warm lighting and a sleek wooden interior and it’s perfect for enjoying a theatrical teppanyaki show. The open-kitchen concept lets you witness your meat or seafood being freshly cooked, adding a layer of intimacy and energy to the setting.
The restaurant is known for delivering three Japanese dining experiences under one roof: teppanyaki, izakaya, and gyukatsu. Menu highlights include Wagyu Gyukatsu MB5+, Fiery Blazing Sushi, and Premium Teppanyaki Rib Eye, all beautifully paired with their signature Yuzu Sour cocktail.
This Canggu restaurant is located on the main street of Jalan Pemelisan Agung, making it easily accessible from popular spots like Berawa Beach or romantic private pool villas such as Ayona Canggu and Aeera Villa.
Prices: typically range from IDR 75,000 to IDR 500,000.
Inspired by a traditional Japanese beach house, YUKI features breezy open walls, bamboo finishes, and soft lighting that blend coastal charm with elegant minimalism. Its effortlessly stylish and warm ambiance makes it a perfect choice for sunset dates and intimate Canggu dinner nights.
This standout in the best restaurants in Canggu list delivers authentic Japanese cuisine prepared with modern twists and elegant presentation. Signature dishes include Torched Salmon, Tuna Tartare, Wagyu Sando, and a special Chocolate Mousse to end your meal on a sweet note.
Conveniently located near Batu Bolong Beach, YUKI artfully fuses Japanese sensibility with coastal Canggu restaurant appeal.
Prices: from IDR 90,000 to IDR 300,000 per dish, well worth the experience for those seeking a fusion of flavor and aesthetic.
Folie is a popular French garden bistro that exudes a romantic and whimsical ambiance, ideal for lunch or dinner with your beloved. With vintage mirrors, pastel-toned walls, and an enchanting backyard, this charming restaurant feels like a secret escape to the countryside of Provence.
The food is a highlight in itself, crafted using local ingredients and plated with artistic flair. It’s no wonder Folie is a favorite among couples looking for the best food in Canggu. Top dishes include creamy risotto, Beef Wellington, and their renowned pastry selection.
This tropical daydream is relatively affordable for its experience. Price may vary depending on the dishes you select, but it remains a solid value in the Canggu restaurants scene.
Prices: starting from IDR 100,000 up to IDR 450,000.
Located on the bustling Jalan Padang Linjong, Cantina Classe immediately captures attention with its exposed brick walls and warm, vintage ambiance, making it one of the most charming restaurants in Canggu. As you walk in, you’re welcomed by dim lighting and soulful music, setting the mood for relaxed dinners and heartfelt conversations.
This standout Italian spot serves wood-fired pizzas and handmade pasta with slow-cooked excellence. Using premium ingredients and traditional techniques, Cantina Classe creates an authentic Italian experience. Be sure to try their Truffle Pizza, Arancini, and Pumpkin Soup, paired with a glass of red sangria.
It’s a romantic yet relaxed place, easily reachable from boutique villas such as Canggu Circle and Kanadea Villa.
Prices: typically under IDR 300,000.
Te’amo means “I love you” in both Spanish and Portuguese, a fitting name for one of the most elegant and romantic restaurants in Canggu. The setting features whitewashed walls, tropical greenery, and airy open spaces that create a warm and whimsical ambiance, ideal for anniversary dinners or even proposals.
Specializing in modern European cuisine, the menu features refined dishes such as Garlic Vongole, Pan-Seared Salmon, and Filet Mignon. The presentation is as exquisite as the taste, making it one of the best restaurants in Canggu for both flavor and aesthetics.
While not the cheapest option, it’s well worth the romantic setting and culinary finesse. Located in the quieter area of Jalan Munduk Catu, the ambiance is elevated further by its peaceful surroundings, perfect for celebrating love in style.
Prices: typically range from IDR 200,000 to IDR 500,000.
Best Restaurants Fine Dining in Canggu
Canggu is home to numerous fine dining restaurants that offer not only exquisite cuisine but also unique dining experiences. Here’s a curated list of the best restaurants in Canggu for an unforgettable culinary journey.
Specializing in Mediterranean cuisine, Luma focuses on seasonal and local produce, blending Southern European culinary traditions with indigenous Balinese ingredients to create beautifully presented and flavorful dishes.
The ambiance is warm and intimate, featuring an open-plan kitchen, earthy textures, and soft lighting, capturing Mediterranean simplicity with a modern twist. Helmed by international chefs Kieran Morland and Cam Emirali, the restaurant aims to highlight local flavors with a fine dining touch.
Must-try menu items include croquettes, lobster, and tiger prawns, accompanied by handcrafted cocktails and curated wine selections. They also offer a chef’s tasting menu, a bold taste menu with optional wine pairing, making it one of the best restaurants Canggu has for a premium experience.
Price: range from IDR 110,000 to IDR 450,000, for the chef’s tasting menu is IDR850,000 – IDR1,600,000.
One of the most interactive Canggu restaurants, Sa’Mesa Canggu brings the Italian tradition of communal dining to life. With a chic, modern interior, long shared tables, and moody lighting, the atmosphere here feels festive yet refined.
There’s no fixed menu, each guest enjoys a 15+ course degustation experience delivered directly by the chefs, often with storytelling and surprises. It’s an immersive, theatrical dining journey unlike any other.
Though the courses vary, popular dishes have included Porcini Risotto, Charred Octopus, and Truffle Arancini. Tucked away on the quiet Jalan Tanah Barak, it’s a Canggu restaurant ideal for adventurous diners.
Prices: typically starts from IDR 250,000+ per person.
Also located on Jalan Tanah Barak, Santanera is a multi-level Latin-European restaurant and a standout among the best restaurants in Canggu. The space combines industrial design with elegant details, including open-air terraces, vintage chandeliers, and ambient lighting that create a sophisticated yet relaxed vibe.
Santanera’s menu merges bold Latin American flavors with European finesse, using local, sustainable produce under a zero-waste philosophy. Highlights include Dry Aged Duck, Red Snapper Ceviche, and Frozen Cheesecake, offering a balance of creativity and tradition.
This is one of the best restaurants Canggu offers for couples seeking a romantic, upscale dining experience in a visually stunning setting.
Price: IDR110,000 – IDR500,000.
If you’re looking for a French bistro with Canggu charm, Lulu Bistrot is a must-visit. Located in the heart of Canggu, it combines French culinary traditions with Bali’s freshest ingredients. The interior features yellow walls, wooden furniture, vintage chandeliers, and velvet seating, inviting and stylish, with Parisian flair.
Every detail at Lulu, from tableware to music, is thoughtfully curated to elevate your experience. Menu highlights include Seafood Pasta, Steak au Poivre, and their signature Crème Caramel.
High quality food with medium price among fine dining experiences nearby, Lulu is a top contender for the best restaurant Canggu has for casual elegance and fine food.
Price: from IDR 110,000 to IDR 400,000
For those craving Spanish flavors, Sazón delivers bold and rustic tastes rooted in authentic Spanish culinary heritage. With wooden accents, unique chandeliers, tropical plants, and dim lighting, the ambiance exudes warmth and vibrancy.
The menu is designed for sharing and includes Squid Ink Paella, Croquettes, and Patatas Bravas, perfectly paired with signature cocktails. It’s one of the most stylish restaurants in Canggu where you can enjoy elevated Spanish dining with friends or loved ones.
Conveniently located on Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong, it’s just a two-minute walk from the beach, making it a strong candidate for best food Canggu offers near the shoreline.
Prices: typically range from IDR 150,000 to IDR 500,000.
Best Restaurants with Asian Food in Canggu
Canggu is an Asian restaurant that offers bold spices and traditional techniques in cozy and warm settings. Here is the best restaurant with Asian food.
Meimei is a new contender in Canggu that presents a cozy and intimate dining atmosphere with minimalism and moody lighting. The oriental decoration infused enchanting vibes into every moment in this restaurant.
What makes Meimei special is its modern twist on Southeast Asian barbeque, served in stylish portions without losing authenticity. It’s like eating your favorite childhood dish but elevated.
The most favorite dishes here are Roasted Duck, Beef Cheek Curry, and short ribs infused with local Balinese spices. The menu price is a typical mid-scale restaurant in Canggu around IDR150,000 – IDR300,000 per person.
As the name suggests, this restaurant specializes in rice dishes like nasi goreng (Indonesian fried rice), yangzhou fried rice, and many options of rice noodle dishes like pad thai and chow mein. Even though it’s just kind of like street food in Asia, this restaurant successfully elevated it with a beautiful presentation.
This restaurant boasts a bright, Instagram-worthy interior with contemporary Asian décor and open dining space. Comfortable seating and tropical accents make it feel both fun and sophisticated.
Located in the buzzling street Padang Linjong, this restaurant became one of the most affordable restaurants in this area with a price range IDR45,000 – IDR100,000.
The edgy and vibrant interior makes Chow Chow Bali popular among friends or group travelers looking for a one of a kind restaurant for hanging out. The restaurant features pop-art murals, neon lighting, and a bar-forward layout which is this lively setting that matches its explosive flavors.
This modern Asian bistro is known for its flavor-forward dishes with a Southeast Asian soul and quirky cocktail pairings. The kitchen plays with fusion without losing the comfort of classics like Tom Yum Fried Rice, Rendang Tagliatelle, and many options of creative sushi.
The price is also typically affordable which is around IDR90,000 – IDR150,000. The price can be higher if you order the steak menu.
For Asian Food seekers, Paed Thai is your must visit. The restaurant is designed with earthy wood tones and Thai inspired art, creating dining venues that are both authentic and serene, with open-air and tranquil, ideal for slow meals and deep conversations.
The food is cooked by well-trained chefs with Thai cooking techniques and locally sourced ingredients, this spot delivers genuine flavors straight from Thailand with no compromises. Everything is crafted to reflect Bangkok street food meets royal kitchen tradition.
Their must try menu is Tom Yum Goong, Pad Thai, Som Tum, and one of a kind dessert, Jackfruit Creme Brulee. The menu price is around IDR80,000 – IDR200,000, one of the best restaurants in Canggu Padang Linjong.
20. Island Wok Berawa
One thing that makes Asian food unique is the wok hay, a smoky taste from the wok toasting cooking techniques. With retro-style tiles, open-concept kitchens, and vibrant tropical plants, Island Wok captures the casual and colorful side of Asian dining making it ideal for brunch, lunch, or dinner after surfing.
The food is all about affordable, fast, and flavorful Asian bowls, serving Indonesian, Thai, and Chinese comfort food in a modern, fast-casual setting. You should try the Orange Chicken, Pad Thai, Kung Pao Chicken, and Broccoli Beef, that crowded favorite.
Located just 5 minutes walking distance from Berawa Beach, the restaurant is known for the minimalist Asian interior with wooden accent. It’s cozy for lunch or dinner with friends.
Recommendation: Accommodation Near Popular Restaurants in Canggu
There are countless accommodation options in the area, but for foodies, it’s best to stay in a location that gives easy access to the best restaurants in Canggu. Here are top accommodations near popular Canggu restaurants that you should consider.
Canggu Circle is a hidden gem in the heart of Canggu, offering a serene and exclusive setting while still being close to the neighborhood’s top culinary spots like Jalan Pantai Berawa. It’s only 15 minutes away from the vibrant Monsoon Restaurant, a popular Canggu restaurant for food and music lovers.
This villa offers private pool accommodations, making it perfect for couples and families looking for a peaceful sanctuary. The tropical-inspired interiors with subtle Balinese touches create a warm, welcoming atmosphere, ideal after exploring the best restaurants Canggu has to offer.
Tucked away near Berawa, Kanadea Villa blends modern comfort with privacy, just minutes away from some of the best restaurants in Canggu. It’s especially favored by families, offering spacious three-bedroom villas complete with private pools.
As you enter, the villa instantly feels like home. It features a large open yard where children can play freely. Its location is ideal for easy access to foodie-favorite Canggu restaurants such as Island Wok, YUKI Canggu, and Cantina Classe.
While technically located in Seminyak, La Mira Villa offers a seamless connection from Seminyak to the Canggu vibrant dining scene. Popular restaurants in Canggu like Monsoon Restaurant and Lemon & Salt are just a short drive away, making this a great option for those who want to stay in Seminyak without missing out on Canggu’s food experiences.
The villa is known for its cheerful white and yellow interior. What sets La Mira apart is its unique private pool equipped with a waterslide, adding a fun and playful touch to your stay.
Aeera Villa is a boutique hideaway near Berawa Beach that offers chic and romantic villas, each with a private pool and scenic floating bathtub. Located on Gang Semar, right off the main road of Jalan Pantai Berawa, Aeera is within walking distance of several best restaurants in Canggu, making it a dream spot for culinary explorers.
This villa features a unique mezzanine layout, perfect for couples seeking something stylish, intimate, and close to the buzzing food scene of Canggu restaurants.
Combining traditional Balinese elements with modern design, Ayona Canggu is ideally situated near top-rated Canggu restaurants and cafes. Each villa offers a rooftop and sky bedroom, a private pool, and panoramic views, perfect for enjoying sunrise or sunset in Canggu.
It’s also located within walking distance from one of the best restaurants in Canggu, Shichirin Canggu, making it a top choice for food lovers looking to stay close to the action.
