title: 20 Best Restaurants in Sanur, Not Just Highly Reviewed
content:
Restaurants in Sanur are all about good food in a laid-back setting. Unlike the busy vibes of Kuta, Sanur offers a calmer, family-friendly atmosphere that’s perfect if you’re after peace and great eats.
Here, you’ll find everything from local Balinese and Indonesian flavors to international picks like European and Asian dishes. Many spots even serve fresh seafood straight from local fishermen. If you’re planning a food trip, here are 20 of the best restaurants in Sanur you’ll definitely want to try:
1. Tsune Sanur – Authentic Japanese Restaurant
If you’re looking for a unique spot for dinner in Sanur, Tsune is a must-try. This authentic Japanese restaurant in Sanur Bali, is the first in Indonesia to bring the floating sushi concept, where bamboo boats carry your sushi along a mini water channel. The vibe is chic and semi-open, with a rooftop that offers gorgeous ocean views.
Menu highlights include Black Cod Rice Set, Toro Foie Gras Sashimi, and Maguro Zuke Sashimi, all made with premium ingredients. Expect to spend around IDR 200,000–400,000. A perfect pick if you’re staying at a top resort in Sanur..
2. Paed Thai – Thailand Restaurant
If you’re looking for a unique spot for dinner in Sanur. Paed Thai serves authentic dishes with a fresh, modern twist. The open-air setting makes it super laid-back, and there’s even a kids’ play area, so it’s great for families too.
The food here is made with fresh, local ingredients, enriched by Bali’s rich spices. The bold flavors and freshness create a truly premium dining experience. What makes it special is that it’s not only great for dinner but also perfect for a casual hangout.
Signature dishes like Pad Thai Goong, Pork Belly Kaylan, and Tom Yum pack that classic Thai balance of sweet, salty, spicy, and sour. Meals average IDR 100,000–200,000, making it a solid option for casual yet flavorful dining in Sanur. Paed Thai can be an option for romantic activities with your partner.
3. Massimo – Italian Restaurant
When it comes to the best restaurants in Sanur, Massimo is always on the list. This cozy spot has been around for years, serving authentic Italian flavors from the Salento region. Think wood-fired pizzas, fresh pasta, house-made mozzarella and burrata, plus a full gluten-free menu.
But the real star? Their homemade gelato, displayed right at the front, often with a line of eager fans. Prices range from IDR 60,000–128,000, making it a mid-to-high range option that’s worth every bite. Add this to your list if you’re wondering what to do in Bali beyond beaches.
4. Naga Eight Restaurant
For something different, Naga Eight brings authentic Cantonese flavors to Sanur in a stunning garden setting. This spacious restaurant Sanur beach area is perfect for a relaxed meal surrounded by tropical greenery.
Their specialty is barbecue and wok-style Cantonese dishes, with standouts like roast duck and pork char siu. You can also try combo plates featuring duck, samcan, and red roast pork. Prices range from IDR 25,000 to 368,000, so there’s something for every budget. Great options for your itinerary in Bali.
5. Lidah Lokal Sanur
If you’re craving authentic Indonesian flavors, Lidah Lokal is one of the best restaurants in Sanur for a casual lunch. The space is modern and minimalist, but the menu stays true to local favorites like Nasi Rawon, Soto Betawi, plus Sate Ayam and Sate Kambing. Prices are super affordable too, ranging from IDR 20,000–100,000, making it a go-to spot for some of the best food Sanur has to offer. A great place to head to after checking in at your private pool villa.
6. Naughty Nuri’s Sanur
Famous for its smoky pork ribs, Naughty Nuri’s has become a Bali icon, starting in Ubud and now winning hearts in Sanur. The vibe is lively and casual, packed with tourists and locals digging into BBQ favorites like the 1995 Signature Pork Ribs, fried rice, and even martinis. Meals cost around IDR 150,000–250,000, and its location on Jalan Bypass Ngurah Rai makes it super easy to reach. Definitely one of the best food experiences in Sanur if you love barbecue.
7. The Restaurant at Tandjung Sari
For a touch of luxury, The Restaurant at Tandjung Sari is a gem of fine dining in Sanur. Tucked inside the iconic Tandjung Sari Hotel, it offers a serene, elegant atmosphere with a menu of Balinese and international dishes. Expect premium-quality seafood, pasta, and grilled plates, with meals starting from IDR 300,000 per person. Located right on Sanur Beach, it’s not just about the food, the ocean views make this one of the best restaurants in Sanur for a romantic evening.
8. Blossom Steakhouse Sanur
Blossom Steakhouse is one of the newest and best places to eat in Sanur, opening in mid-2024 inside Icon Bali Mall. With a luxe interior and stunning Sanur Beach views, it’s the perfect spot for a fancy night out. Led by chef Brenton Banner, the menu highlights premium steaks, fresh seafood like lobster, short ribs, oysters, burgers, and salads. Expect to spend at least IDR 500,000 per person, but the quality and portions are worth it. Just 45 minutes from the airport, it’s a great dinner stop before checking into your villas in Bali.
9. Brasserie République
For a taste of Paris in Bali, Brasserie République delivers a chic, early 20th-century café vibe right in the heart of Sanur’s dining strip. The menu features French classics like Coq au Vin, steak with green pepper sauce and fries, plus rich chocolate lava cake. Prices are mid-to-high, but the atmosphere and flavors make it one of the best places to eat in Sanur if you’re craving something elegant yet casual.
10. Lava Gastrobar & Grill
If you love smoky grills and creative cocktails, Lava Gastrobar & Grill is a must. This stylish spot blends restaurant-quality cuisine with the laid-back vibe of a gastrobar. Think juicy steaks, burrata, risotto, prawns, and even papaya salad, all kissed by their volcanic grill. Pair it with one of their signature cocktails for the full experience. Prices sit mid-to-high, but it’s solid value for money and easily one of the best places to eat in Sanur after a day relaxing at your villa with private pool.
11. Kaluma Casual Dining & Bar
Kaluma, tucked inside Tamukami Hotel, is a laid-back spot perfect for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. With a cozy mix of modern design and Balinese touches, plus live music in the evenings, it’s a great hangout. The menu blends local and international dishes, with favorites like chicken parma, grilled tenderloin, seafood platters, and tempting desserts. Prices for mains range from IDR 60,000–150,000, making it one of the Best Indonesian Restaurants Sanur if you’re after comfort food at a fair price.
12. COSTA – Beach Restaurant Sanur
COSTA is the kind of Italian restaurant in Sanur that makes dining by the ocean unforgettable. Serving Mediterranean and Italian flavors, it’s known for fresh seafood, great cocktails, and a romantic vibe enhanced by live music. Prices are mid-to-upper range, but with direct beach access and stunning views, it’s easily one of the Best Restaurants in Sanur Beach for a sunset dinner.
13. Sand Beach Bar & Restaurant
For a casual day-to-night vibe, Sand Beach Bar & Restaurant hits the mark. Right outside Icon Bali Mall, this beachfront spot is relaxed and family-friendly, with a menu that ranges from Asian classics to international favorites, including seafood. Affordable prices and panoramic sea views make it one of the Best Restaurants in Sanur Beach for anyone looking to unwind with good food and a chilled atmosphere.
14. The Royal Kitchen Sanur
If you’re craving authentic Indian flavors, The Royal Kitchen is a top pick on Tripadvisor Sanur Restaurants. With its elegant vibe and fine dining setup, it’s perfect for family dinners or special occasions. Expect classics like butter chicken, tandoori, and biryani cooked with rich spices. Prices fall in the mid-to-high range, around IDR 150,000–300,000 per person. Located on Jl. By Pass Ngurah Rai No. 100, this restaurant Sanur is easy to reach and even has plenty of parking.
Mozza is a modern, relaxed spot that’s all about steaks, seafood, and international comfort food. From grilled specialties to pasta, salads, and pizza, the menu is diverse and crowd-pleasing. With prices around IDR 150,000–250,000 per person, it’s a solid mid-range option. Situated on Jl. Danau Tamblingan No. 134, it’s close to shops and hotels, making it a convenient choice for those hunting the best restaurant in Sanur.
16. Tree Bar at Maya Sanur
Tree Bar at Maya Sanur Resort & Spa is where design meets elegance. Built around a massive banyan tree with views of the ocean, it’s a serene spot for cocktails, tapas, and light bites. Known for its creative drinks and tranquil setting, it’s definitely one of the best restaurants in Sanur if you want a mix of style and flavor. Prices are premium, about IDR 100,000–200,000 per dish or drink, but the beachfront atmosphere makes it worth it.
17. SEJA Restaurant & Bar
Looking for something stylish in Sanur? SEJA Restaurant & Bar brings modern cuisine with a Balinese twist in a sleek, elegant setting overlooking the pool. It’s the kind of place made for a romantic dinner or sipping cocktails in the afternoon.
The menu highlights premium meats, fresh seafood, and creative cocktails, all crafted with a fine dining touch. Prices are premium too, around IDR 200,000–500,000+ per person, but the vibe makes it worth it. You’ll find SEJA tucked away on Jalan Sudamala No. 4, in a quieter part of Sanur.
18. Three Monkeys Sanur
Three Monkeys is a relaxed, easygoing spot serving up Mediterranean and Italian comfort food. Famous in Ubud, their Sanur branch keeps the same welcoming vibe with pizzas, pastas, grilled ribs, seafood, and indulgent desserts.
Prices are mid-range, with mains around IDR 100,000–250,000. Located on Jalan Danau Tamblingan No. 192, it’s right in the heart of Sanur and super easy to find. Perfect for a laid-back lunch or dinner.
19. CORK Bistro & Wine Bar
If you love good wine and cozy bistro eats, CORK Bistro & Wine Bar should be on your list. This spot is intimate and elegant, with a wide wine collection, both local and imported, ready to pair with your meal.
Signature dishes include steak frites, charcuterie boards, and pasta. Expect to spend around IDR 200,000+ per person for dinner and wine. Conveniently located on Jalan Danau Tamblingan No. 128, it’s right in the lively center of Sanur.
20. Soul On The Beach
Soul On The Beach sits right on Sindhu Beach, making it one of the chillest dining spots in Sanur with views of the ocean, Mount Agung, and even Nusa Penida in the distance. The vibe is rustic and eco-friendly, with interiors made from recycled materials that give it a warm, laid-back charm.
The menu is a mix of international, Asian, and Indonesian favorites, think pizza, pasta, and local classics, all paired perfectly with cocktails crafted by their in-house mixologist. Food runs around IDR 60,000–200,000, while drinks range from IDR 15,000–495,000. You’ll find it beachfront on Jalan Pantai Sindhu, right next to Inna Bali Hotel. Perfect for unwinding with good food and ocean breezes.
Enjoy More Culinary Experiences in Sanur
Restaurant Sanur offers a mix of flavors and vibes, from laid-back beachfront spots to elegant fine dining. Whether you’re craving local Balinese dishes, authentic Italian pizza, Japanese sushi, or smoky BBQ, Sanur is the perfect place to slow down and enjoy Bali’s culinary side in a more relaxed setting.
To make your dining adventure even better, stay with Ini Vie Hospitality, the best hospitality brand in Bali. With their stunning villas and resorts, you’ll have the perfect base to explore the best restaurants Sanur has to offer.

title: 7 Restoran Mewah di Bali dengan Suasana Romantis dan View Cantik
content:
Merayakan momen penting bersama pasangan di restoran mewah di Bali akan terasa spesial. Ini karena di Pulau Dewata saat ini banyak tempat yang cocok untuk dinner romantis bersama pasangan.
Berbagai pilihan restoran dengan suasana romantis dan view cantik dapat dipilih untuk membuat kenangan makan bersama pasangan tidak terlupakan. Jika bingung memilih restoran, simak penjelasan 7 restoran mewah di Bali yang cocok untuk merayakan makan malam romantis.
Terra Verte menjadi restoran di Bali yang menawarkan pengalaman berkesan bagi pasangan. Restoran mewah ini dikelola oleh The Wonderspace dan terletak di jantung budaya Pulau Dewata, yaitu Ubud.
Meskipun mengusung konsep restoran Italian-Mediterranean, Terra Verte tetap mempertahankan nuansa lokal dengan menggunakan arsitektur dari bambu, menambahkan kesan magis, membuat pengunjung betah dalam menikmati santapan mereka.
Nilai plus dari restoran ini adalah pemandangan langsung ke area sawah 180 derajat. Pemandangan ini menghasilkan atmosfer menenangkan bagi para pengunjung.
Sebagai restoran mewah di Bali, Terra Verte menghadirkan menu menggugah selera yang menjadi highlight tersendiri, seperti handmade pasta dengan saus light dan balanced, bahan-bahan segar, dan presentasi hidangan minimalis namun elegan.
Terra Verte sendiri menunjukkan keahlian Chef Armen dalam menghidangkan sajian yang fresh dan kreatif. Sajian terasa spesial, terlebih bagi pasangan yang ingin merasakan Italian-Mediterranean cuisine di Bali.
Setelah menyantap hidangan di Terra Verte, Anda dapat berpindah lokasi ke Equipoise, salah satu hotel baru terbaik di Ubud, untuk beristirahat. Equipoise sendiri merupakan resor mewah yang memiliki fasilitas lengkap dan pemandangan persawahan yang menenangkan.
Alamat: Jl. Raya Desa Kenderan, Kenderan, Kec. Tegallalang, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80561
Habitat Resto sebagai resto mewah di Bali tetap menjadi tempat makan yang wajib dikunjungi karena memiliki poin plus tersendiri. Konsep modern bistro dengan sentuhan hutan tropis membuat pemandangan di Habitat Resto terasa sangat segar dan membawa angin sejuk.
Bahkan, terdapat infinity pool untuk Anda yang ingin bersenang-senang di air dengan pemandangan hutan hujan Ubud yang indah. Perayaan momen romantis pun semakin berkesan.
Menu yang dihidangkan oleh restoran ini pun bervariasi. Tetapi memiliki core yang sama, yaitu Western comfort food. Anda dapat menikmati all-day breakfast, pasta, dan kopi dengan light bites.
Anda tidak boleh melewatkan momen makan bersama di Habitat Resto. Momen menikmati makanan dengan pemandangan hutan hujan Ubud akan menambah pengalaman kuliner tak terlupakan,
Habitat Resto sendiri terletak di Kaamala Resort, salah satu akomodasi mewah untuk honeymoon di Ubud. Tempat penginapan ini sendiri menawarkan kamar dengan view cantik. Contohnya seperti Suits Forest View Room yang menghadap langsung ke hutan.
Alamat: Jl. Bisma No.888A, Ubud, Kecamatan Ubud, Kabupaten Gianyar, Bali 80571
Tsune Uluwatu tidak hanya sekadar restoran Jepang biasa. Terletak di Seascape Uluwatu, sebuah resort yang berada di kawasan selatan Bali.
Momen makan malam mewah di Tsune Uluwatu akan menjadi pengalaman tidak terlupakan. Ini karena restoran tersebut menghadirkan sajian Jepang otentik dengan presentasi modern yang membuat sushi, sashimi, dan teppanyaki terlihat lebih ‘appetizing’.
Dengan atmosfer menenangkan dan terasa sangat intim, Tsune Uluwatu menjadi salah satu tempat untuk merayakan Valentine bersama pasangan. Restoran ini menyediakan candlelight dinner experience dengan pilihan menu yang bervariasi.
Alamat: Seascape Uluwatu Complex, Jl. Labuansait, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
4. Koral: Bali’s First Aquarium Restaurant
Koral menawarkan pengalaman menyantap hidangan berbeda dari restoran lainnya. Pasangan akan dibawa ke aquarium tunnel dengan ikan berenang ke sana-kemari.
Konsep restoran ini sangat bold karena menawarkan visual storytelling. Sebuah cerita dari koki profesional memberikan gambaran kuat tentang makanan yang dihidangkan. Pengalaman inilah yang memberikan kesan tidak mudah dilupakan.
Tidak hanya itu, presentasi hidangan di Koral juga terbilang artistik. Setiap makanan disajikan dengan konsep berbeda, memberikan kesan berbeda di setiap lapisan hidangan dari koki andalan Koral.
Alamat: Jl. Raya Nusa Dua Selatan, Sawangan, Nusa Dua, Kabupaten Badung, Bali
The Cave mengusung konsep underground fine dining yang menawarkan atmosfer sinematis. Pengunjung akan merasakan natural cave walls, lighting dramatis, dan suasana hening.
Restoran ini mengadopsi konsep fine dining tasting menu. Biasanya, Chef Ryan Clift akan menghidangkan menu 7-10 course yang setiap layernya memiliki cita rasa berbeda. Menu yang disajikan pun dalam bentuk fusion, yaitu sajian Western dan Asian.
Sebagai restoran yang menawarkan atmosfer romantis, The Cave turut menjadi alasan mengapa Bali menjadi destinasi nomor satu untuk liburan romantis. Momen romansa ini akan melekat sangat kuat sebagai core memory Anda danpasangan.
Alamat: Jalan Pura Goa Lempeh, Banjar Dinas Kangin, Jl. Goa Lempeh, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
Kayuputi merupakan restoran mewah di Bali yang mengusung konsep klasik dengan santapan mewah tepi pantai menakjubkan. Restoran ini merupakan bagian dari The St. Regis yang ada di Nusa Dua.
Dominasi warna putih dan pemandangan tepi laut Nusa Dua membuat Kayuputi sangat memorable bagi pengunjung. Restoran ini dilengkapi dengan interior klasik dengan sentuhan kolonial-modern.
Fokus pada fine dining Western cuisine, Kayuputi menawarkan menu premium seafood dengan teknik klasik namun dieksekusi secara modern. Hal inilah yang membuat santapan di Kayuputi terasa sangat menakjubkan.
Bahkan, Kayuputi menjadi salah satu restoran terbaik untuk merayakan Chinese New Year di Bali dengan santapan menggugah selera. Pengunjung dapat mengajak keluarga untuk menyantap berbagai menu di Kayuputi.
Alamat: The St. Regis, Jalan Nusa Dua, Benoa, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80363
Terakhir, terdapat Restoran Mauri yang menjadi salah satu resto mahal di Bali untuk dicoba. Terletak di kawasan Seminyak, tempat makan ini menawarkan momen menyantap hidangan yang berbeda.
Restoran Mauri merupakan restoran Italia dengan contemporary cuisine. Koki andalan resto ini menghidangkan sajian Italia dengan konsep plating yang cantik, membuat pengalaman menyantap makanan jadi lebih ‘hidup’ dan berkesan.
Interior yang clean dan atmosfer yang tenang membuat momen makan bersama pasangan terasa sangat romantis. Pasangan dapat menikmati fine dining tanpa adanya interupsi dari bisingnya dunia luar.
Di sini, pengunjung dapat berinteraksi langsung dengan koki yang siap memberikan informasi tentang lapisan setiap masakan. Inilah yang membuat momen menyantap hidangan di Restoran Mauri terasa jauh lebih mengesankan.
Terletak tidak jauh dari Canggu, pasangan yang sedang berbulan madu dapat menginap di honeymoon resort yang menakjubkan. Momen berlibur terasa jauh lebih menyenangkan.
Tidak hanya itu saja, para pasangan yang sedang berbulan madu dapat mengunjungi beberapa restoran di Canggu untuk merayakan momen romantis mereka. Salah satu contoh restoran terkenal di kawasan tersebut adalah Ketela Eatery and Lifestyle.
Merayakan momen romantis juga dapat dilakukan dengan memilih paket liburan di Bali yang menawarkan pengalaman berbeda. Ini Vie Hospitality sendiri memiliki penawaran paket liburan yang romantis, cocok bagi pasangan yang ingin berbulan madu di Bali.
Lengkapi Momen Spesialmu dengan Akomodasi Mewah di Ini Vie Hospitality
Momen menikmati santapan menakjubkan di restoran mewah di Bali akan menjadi pengalaman yang sangat berkesan. Seluruh restoran di atas menawarkan atmosfer intim yang membuat momen makan bersama terasa jauh lebih ‘hidup’ dan mewah.
Untuk memperkaya momen spesial di Bali, kamu dapat memilih akomodasi mewah di Ini Vie Hospitality sebagai tempat beristirahat setelah momen makan bersama. Kenali lebih dalam akomodasi milik kami dan pilih satu penginapan yang sesuai dengan preferensi kamu!

title: 10 Restoran Teppanyaki di Bali yang Wajib Dikunjungi
content:
Menjelajahi wisata kuliner untuk menikmati teppanyaki di Bali merupakan pilihan yang tepat. Anda dapat menyaksikan live cooking teppanyaki, dari atraksi api, penggunaan spatula yang lihai, hingga omotenashi yang membuat pengalaman kuliner tak terlupakan.
Dalam artikel ini, Anda akan menemukan beberapa rekomendasi tempat makan teppanyaki dengan cita rasa nikmat. Mari simak penjelasan tentang 10 restoran teppanyaki di Bali berikut ini.
10 Rekomendasi Restoran Teppanyaki di Bali
Restoran teppanyaki di Bali cukup bervariasi. Anda dapat menemukannya di berbagai hotspot turis yang mudah dijangkau. Inilah alasan mengapa Anda harus mencoba kuliner teppanyaki setelah melakukan aktivitas sehari-hari, seperti pilates.
1. Rayjin Teppanyaki – Petitenget
Rayjin Teppanyaki Bali adalah restoran teppanyaki yang wajib dikunjungi ketika berada di kawasan Petitenget. Tempat ini terkenal karena menghadirkan kombinasi rasa hidangan Jepang autentik dengan bahan dasar premium serta live teppanyaki performance.
Menu Rayjin Teppanyaki sendiri bervariasi, dimulai dari premium Wagyu, Australian Beef Tenderloin, Lobster, hingga sushi dan sashimi yang fresh. Seluruh sajian ini dibuat dari bahan-bahan segar yang membuat cita rasanya sangat kaya.
Restoran Jepang di Bali yang mewah ini cocok untuk berbagai acara. Anda dapat mengadakan acara dinner bersama pasangan, perayaan hari ulang tahun, group gathering, dan business dinner di area regular.
Berjarak tidak jauh dari kawasan hostel di Canggu, Anda dapat memilih Rayjin Teppanyaki sebagai tempat makan malam mewah. Ini menjadikan perjalanan kuliner menjadi jauh lebih menyenangkan.
Alamat: Jl. Petitenget No.98x, Kerobokan Kelod, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
2. Shima Teppanyaki & Shabu Shabu – Seminyak
Shima Teppanyaki di Bali merupakan salah satu restoran Jepang legendaris di Seminyak. Ini karena restoran tersebut terkenal dengan pengalaman teppanyaki dan shabu-shabu dengan atmosfer yang elegan dan autentik.
Anda dapat merasakan sajian Jepang autentik dari Wagyu Beef Teppanyaki, Fresh Lobster, Premium Shabu-shabu Set, dan Sushi-Sashimi selection. Inilah yang membuat Shima Teppanyaki menjadi tempat yang cocok bagi Anda untuk wisata kuliner.
Jika bosan dengan hidangan Indonesia, Anda dapat mengunjungi Shima Teppanyaki dan menikmati sajian premium dengan atraksi koki yang menakjubkan. Pengalaman ini memuaskan seluruh indera dalam tubuh, menjadikan pengalaman tak terlupakan.
Alamat: Jalan Petitenget No.5E, Kerobokan Kelod, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80361
3. SONO Teppanyaki – Anantara Uluwatu
Jika Anda sedang berada di Uluwatu, Anda tidak boleh melewatkan kesempatan untuk mengunjungi SONO Teppanyaki Anantara untuk makan malam. Ini lantaran restoran SONO teppanyaki menawarkan suasana yang intim dan refined.
Anda dapat menikmati sunset di peninsula Uluwatu dengan hidangan spesial dari SONO Teppanyaki. Selain itu, pemandangan lautan Samudra Hindia juga memperkuat memori kuliner yang tak terlupakan di restoran teppanyaki Uluwatu ini.
Sajian menu premium, seperti Wagyu, Australian Beef, dan Sushi-sashimi selection, membuat SONO Teppanyaki spesial. Anda dapat menjadikan restoran ini sebagai tempat menikmati teppanyaki bersama keluarga di Bali.
Alamat: Jl. Pemutih Labuan Sait, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Uluwatu, Bali 80361
4. Edogin – The Mulia Bali
Terletak di kawasan The Mulia Bali, Edogin terkenal sebagai restoran Teppanyaki wagyu di Bali yang autentik. Atmosfer elegan menghadirkan pengalaman menikmati menu teppanyaki yang tidak terlupakan.
Menu spesial pun menjadi highlight utama dari restoran ini. Anda dapat menikmati Japanese A5 Wagyu Teppanyaki, Fresh Lobster dan King Prawn, dan Premium Sushi serta sashimi.
Alamat: Mulia Resort, Kawasan Sawangan, Jl. Raya Nusa Dua Selatan, Benoa, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80362
5. Honzen – AYANA Bali
Honzen adalah salah satu restoran live cooking Jepang di Bali. Anda dapat melihat bagaimana koki melakukan atraksi dengan lihai dalam menyajikan teppanyaki dengan cita rasa yang luar biasa.
Kombinasi hidangan teppanyaki, sushi, robatakai, hingga kaiseki membuat restoran ini spesial. Anda dapat menikmati berbagai macam hidangan yang memperkaya cita rasa di lidah, sehingga menjadi kenangan tak terlupakan.
Restoran ini sangat cocok untuk dijadikan tempat dinner yang romantis. Tidak hanya itu, Anda pun bisa mengadakan anniversary celebration hingga honeymoon dinner di Honzen, Jimbaran ini.
Alamat: AYANA Resort and Spa, BALI Jl. Karang Mas Sejahtera, Jimbaran, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80364
6. Shichirin – Canggu dan Ubud
Setelah seharian penuh shopping di kawasan Canggu, Anda dapat memanjakan diri dengan menikmati hidangan teppanyaki nikmat di Shichirin. Restoran ini menggabungkan teppanyaki dengan konsep restoran Jepang kontemporer.
Sebagai restoran teppanyaki di Canggu, Bali, Shichirin adalah pilihan yang tepat untuk dikunjungi jika Anda ingin menikmati Wagyu premium dan salmon segar. Anda juga dapat menikmati robatayaki yang menggugah selera.

title: 17 Romantic Things to Do in Bali, Full of Intimacy and Romance
content:
Romantic things to do in Bali are endless, making it one of the top destinations for couples around the world. Known as the “Island of the Gods,” Bali combines stunning natural beauty with rich culture and warm hospitality. From its beautiful white sandy beaches and lush rice paddies to tropical forests and cool mountain views, this Island of the Gods has it all.
Bali is also a hub of art and culture, with traditional dances, religious ceremonies, and unique architecture that showcase the island’s charm. It’s no surprise that this island is often considered one of the most romantic places on Earth, making it a perfect getaway for honeymoons, pre-wedding photoshoots, anniversaries, and more. So if you’re planning to come here, here are 15 romantic things to do in Bali, full of intimacy and romance.
Romantic Things To Do in Bali for Honeymoon
1. Stay in the Adult-Only Resort or Villa
Staying in an adults-only resort or villa offers maximum privacy and tranquility, undisturbed by the hustle and bustle of families or children. The atmosphere is made more intimate with amenities like private pools, jacuzzis, floating breakfasts, and personalized service that allow couples to focus on enjoying time together.
The architecture, views, and service are usually designed to create a romantic experience without distractions. Recommended resorts for couples seeking intimacy include Asvara Resort in Ubud and Seascape Resort Uluwatu. Both resorts are designed for honeymooners seeking a more luxurious experience and are among the best luxury hotels for a romantic escape. These resorts are perfect for couples who want to add a luxurious touch to their itinerary Bali.
2. Helicopter Tour in Bali
Seeing Bali from the air offers an extraordinary perspective, white sandy beaches, terraced rice fields, the cliffs of Uluwatu, and the blue sea stretching out below. This experience is not only a feast for the eyes but also creates spectacular moments rarely experienced.
For couples, a helicopter ride together symbolizes adventure and luxury, adding to the special experience of a vacation. It’s one of the most unique things to do in Bali for couples looking to enjoy some thrills in the sky.
If you’re unsure which helicopter service to choose, let Rosie take you on a journey like no other. Offering a unique sensory experience, Rosie doesn’t just fly you over the island, it transforms the entire journey into a romantic and unforgettable experience.
3. Spa Couple Package
Bali is famous for its world-class spas that combine traditional massage techniques, natural herbs, and a tropical atmosphere. This spa package for couples not only provides physical relaxation but also strengthens emotional connections.
This activity creates a calm, intimate, and comfortable moment, especially when done in a spa room with a view of the ocean, river, or forest. Many spas offer this package, but one of the best is Svaha Spa, a renowned name in holistic wellness. With locations in Sanur, Ubud, Canggu, Seminyak, and Uluwatu, Svaha Spa is known for offering an unforgettable experience in one of the most beautiful romantic things to do in Bali.
4. Private Candlelit Romantic Dinner
A candlelit dinner is one of the ultimate Bali activities for couples to create a special, intimate moment. This island offers tons of amazing locations, whether it’s on the beach, on a rooftop with stunning sunset views, or in a tropical garden.
It’s the perfect way to enjoy delicious food and meaningful conversation without any distractions. You can experience this kind of private dining at spots like Ankhusa Bali or Shichirin Ubud, both of which offer exceptional food and a romantic setting.
5. Flower Decor on the Bathtub
A flower petal-filled bathtub is one of those Bali couple fun moments that’s both beautiful and relaxing. The soothing scent and pretty visuals make it an unforgettable experience, perfect for unwinding and enjoying a bit of luxury.
Resorts like Asvara Resort and Seascape Resort Uluwatu offer this special touch, adding a personalized element to your stay that’s sure to create lasting memories.
6. Romantic Candles on the Bed
Candles on the bed set the perfect romantic mood. The soft lighting creates a cozy and intimate atmosphere, perfect for a special night in. This is often paired with flower petals, heart-shaped towels, or little surprises to make the experience even more magical. It’s one of those simple yet meaningful details that make a night unforgettable.
7. Floating Tray Breakfast
A floating tray breakfast by the pool is one of the most popular Bali date ideas. Imagine waking up to a delicious meal served right in the water, surrounded by stunning views or in the privacy of your own pool. It’s the perfect way to start a relaxed, romantic day with your partner.
8. Full Romance on the Bed
Transform your bed into a romantic haven with flowers, candles, and special touches. This simple yet meaningful gesture will surprise your partner, creating intimate memories and showing how much you care. It’s one of those romantic things to do in Ubud that makes a special occasion even more magical.
9. Floating Balloons in the Pool
Set a playful and celebratory vibe with floating balloons in the pool. This fun idea creates a cheerful atmosphere, perfect for marking special moments like a honeymoon, anniversary, or just enjoying quality time together in this island. Plus, it makes for a great photo op to capture your memories!
Romantic Things To Do in Bali at Night
10. Cocktails and Sunset at a Beach Club
Nothing beats sipping cocktails while watching the sunset at a beach club. The mix of relaxing music, ocean views, and the stunning sunset sky creates a romantic vibe you can only get in Bali. If you’re looking for lively beach clubs, Canggu is popular with its buzzing entertainment scene.
But for a more intimate experience, Uluwatu is the spot, and Tropical Temptation Beach Club offers beautiful sunset views, making it one of the best places to visit in Bali for couples.
A romantic dinner in Bali, whether it’s on the beach, on a rooftop, or in the comfort of a private villa, sets the perfect mood for intimacy. Candlelight and delicious food make the evening feel extra special. Before dinner, you can visit one of the cozy cafes for a laid-back starter or dive into traditional snacks. It’s a more relaxed but still romantic experience, adding charm to your Bali getaway.
12. Dance at the Most Popular Club
To end your romantic evening with a bang, hit one of Bali’s most popular clubs for some dancing. It’s a fun and energetic way to break from routine, enjoy the music, and share some laughs with your partner. You can also find the best beer and wine in Bali’s top clubs. Bali’s nightlife offers a lively atmosphere, making it one of the exciting places to visit in Bali for couples.
13. Intimate Cocktail Bar
Visiting an intimate cocktail bar during a romantic getaway in Bali offers a warm, tranquil, and personal experience. With dim lighting, soft music, and thoughtfully crafted drinks, the atmosphere encourages deep conversation and emotional connection.
These spaces also offer greater privacy, allowing couples to enjoy time together without the distractions of crowds. Perfect for ending the day on an elegant and intimate note.
Romantic places in Bali for Honeymoon
Tirta Gangga is a peaceful water palace with a rich history from the Karangasem kingdom. The clear pools, stunning stone statues, lush gardens, and serene waterways create a perfect romantic setting. It’s an ideal spot for couples to take beautiful photos and enjoy quiet moments together while soaking in Bali’s cultural charm. Definitely one of the unique places to visit in Bali for couples.
15. Lempuyang Temple
Lempuyang Temple is famous for its breathtaking “Gates of Heaven,” offering a dramatic view of Mount Agung in the background. The temple’s beautiful architecture and sacred vibe make it a meaningful place for couples. A photo at the iconic gate is a romantic symbol of new beginnings and shared hopes in married life.
16. Romantic Dive with Manta Rays
Diving with manta rays around Nusa Penida is a one-of-a-kind experience, perfect for couples seeking adventure. Swimming alongside these graceful creatures creates an unforgettable moment of awe and excitement. It’s an adventure that deepens your bond, making it a unique and magical addition to your honeymoon.
17. Waterfalls in Ubud
The waterfalls in Ubud, like Tegenungan or Tibumana, offer the perfect romantic backdrop. With the soothing sound of flowing water and lush tropical scenery, these spots are ideal for quiet moments together. Whether you’re relaxing by the water or splashing around in the natural pools, these peaceful places make for beautiful memories and are great spots for photos. Perfect for couples looking for romantic things to do in Ubud.
Create a beautiful surprise for your partner in Bali!
Bali offers endless romantic things to do, from intimate candlelit dinners on the beach to adventurous dives with manta rays. The island’s natural beauty, luxury resorts, and unique experiences make it the perfect destination for couples.
However, while this island is known for its warm hospitality, it’s important to respect the local culture. Public displays of affection, like kissing in public, are generally frowned upon due to the conservative culture. It’s always best to embrace the local customs and enjoy your time together in a more private setting.
For a truly romantic stay, choose Ini Vie Hospitality for luxurious accommodations in Bali, making it an unforgettable getaway for couples seeking relaxation and intimacy in paradise.

title: Sanur Harbour Guide 2026: Location, Boat Schedules, and Ticket Prices
content:
Sanur is renowned for its spectacular sunrises and calm ocean waters, serving as the perfect peaceful hub where the new Icon Bali mall stands proudly, which makes it the absolute best area to stay for a relaxing coastal holiday. Here is the complete list of everything you need to know about navigating the new Sanur Harbour for your next island adventure.
The Transformation of Sanur Harbour: What’s New in 2026?
The days of holding your luggage high and wading through seawater to reach your boat are completely gone. The new Sanur Beach Harbour features a massive and beautifully designed terminal building that brings airport-level comfort to your island transfer.
Inside, passengers are welcomed by spacious and fully air-conditioned waiting areas equipped with comfortable seating and highly organized ticketing counters that make checking in an absolute breeze.
The most exciting upgrade is the permanent installation of proper floating docks and sturdy walkways for safe and effortless boarding. You no longer have to stand outside in the hot tropical sun, as this impressive modern facility ensures thousands of daily passengers can smoothly walk onto their fast boats with perfectly dry feet and zero stress.
Location and How to Get to Sanur Harbour from Major Bali Hubs
Getting to the terminal is very easy if you follow the right Sanur Harbour directions from your specific location. If you are traveling from Kuta, Seminyak, or the Ngurah Rai International Airport, the drive usually takes about 40 to 50 minutes using the Bali Mandara Toll Road. It is highly recommended to use a reliable taxi or a private driver to drop you off directly at the main entrance.
If you’re traveling from Kuta and Seminyak, you can choose online transportation like Gojek or Grab to book a car. The cost estimate is around Rp120.000-180.000 from Kuta and Rp 150.000–220.000. You can choose to rent a private car and driver if you travel with big group, minimizing the cost itself.
While at Ngurah Rai Airport, you can book official taxis at the arrival hall there with an estimated cost of around Rp200.000-250.000. The travel time is around 25-40 minutes, depending into the traffics and rush hour.
Popular Fast Boat Operators and Their Destinations
This bustling port connects travelers to some of the most beautiful islands in Indonesia. Here are the top routes you can easily book for your next adventure:
The route from sanur harbour to nusa penida is incredibly popular for exciting day trips. It is the perfect choice if you want to see the famous dinosaur-shaped cliff and swim in crystal clear waters. You can choose Angel Bilabong Fast Cruise to Nusa Penida with reasonable prices, and the estimated time to travel is around 35 minutes.
You can easily catch a quick boat from Sanur Harbour to Nusa Lembongan for a deeply relaxing coastal holiday. This charming island is highly loved for its quiet surfing escapes and beautiful mangrove forests. To visit Nusa Lembongan, you can book a fast boat operator, like Maruti Express that easy to book. The estimated time to sail there is around 30-45 minutes.
If you want a fun weekend getaway, take a longer scenic ride from Sanur Harbour to Gili Trawangan. This tropical paradise offers amazing turtle snorkeling spots and incredibly vibrant beachside restaurants.
Updated Boat Schedules and Ticket Prices for 2026
Schedules at sanur harbour bali typically start very early, with the first boats leaving around 7:30 AM and the last ones departing by 5:00 PM. Ticket prices usually range from IDR 150,000 to IDR 400,000, depending on your exact destination and the boat operator you choose.
If you are planning your holiday budget carefully, you can read more about how much it costs to go to bali to manage your travel expenses effectively.
Essential Travel Tips for a Hassle-Free Boarding Experience
Always aim to arrive and check in at least 45 minutes before your scheduled departure time to avoid any rush. Although the new docks keep your feet dry, it is still smart to wear comfortable clothes and easy-to-remove sandals for the boat ride. While waiting, you can explore other great things to do in Sanur or just admire the stunning Sunrise Beach right outside the terminal windows.
When traveling by fast boat from Sanur Harbour to the islands, luggage handling can be different from airports or ferries. You should pack light and smart by bringing compact luggage or backpacks. If it is possible, keep the luggage you bring under 20 kg.
You also have to bring a small bag with a passport or ID within it, a phone and wallet, and motion sickness tablets. A water bottle and sunscreen can also be included in the small bag, making your traveling more comfortable.

The modern port area is fully equipped with massive long-term parking spaces for cars and scooters.
