title: 10 Unique Hotels in the World: Extraordinary Stays
content:
When choosing a hotel, most people heavily consider comfort, facilities, and luxurious rooms. But a handful of unique hotels around the world offer something entirely unexpected, with concepts and locations unlike anything you’ve seen before.
They don’t just give you a place to sleep, but fish swimming past your window, ice walls glowing blue at night, or a cliffside capsule suspended on a sheer cliff face. In this article, we’ve rounded up some of the world’s most unique hotels and the extraordinary stays they offer.
10 Most Unique Hotels in the World (2026)
While unique hotels are often more expensive than regular stays, they offer a rare experience worth having once in your lifetime. Here are some of the world’s most unique hotels worth knowing about and adding to your bucket list.
1. Conrad Maldives Rangali Island – Underwater Suite
The Maldives, in South Asia, is famous for its crystal-clear turquoise beaches and is often picked as a top honeymoon destination for anyone craving tropical views that stop you in your tracks. But hidden beneath those waters is something few travelers expect to find: an underwater hotel you can actually sleep in, called Conrad Maldives Rangali Island.
The resort’s star attraction is The Muraka, a two-story underwater hotel suite where the lower level sits 16 feet below the Indian Ocean’s surface. It’s considered the world’s first underwater residence of its kind, offering guests a once-in-a-lifetime stay priced at around $50,000 a night.
Sleeping here feels like living inside an endless aquarium. Curved, transparent acrylic walls wrap around the room, letting you watch marine life glide by in calm silence, from sharks to rays to schools of colorful fish. Even 16 feet beneath the ocean, this underwater hotel still delivers five-star luxury, including a 24-hour private butler, a personal chef, and more.
2. Icehotel, Jukkasjärvi, Sweden – Arctic Ice Rooms
Icehotel in Jukkasjärvi, Sweden, is one of the most unique hotels in the world. While most hotels give you a warm, cozy space to escape the cold outside, this one is entirely built and carved from ice, letting you sleep in a room with ice walls artfully lit to create a glowing, dreamlike atmosphere at night.
The hotel stays between -5 and -8°C, with two room types to choose from: Ice Rooms, featuring a bed made of solid ice topped with reindeer hides and a thermal sleeping bag, and Art Suites, elaborately carved by international artists with custom ice furniture and sculptures. There’s also ICEHOTEL 365, a permanent, solar-cooled structure where you can experience sleeping on ice any time of year, not just winter.
What makes this hotel so unique is that the classic winter version only lasts a season. It melts away each spring and gets rebuilt from scratch every December, so no two years look the same. Despite the icy setting, there’s a warm Riverside Lobby with storage lockers, changing rooms, and a sauna to keep guests comfortable.
3. Skylodge Adventure Suites, Peru – Hanging Cliffside Capsules
Imagine sleeping in a capsule hotel suspended 400 meters above the ground on a cliff face. Would you rest peacefully, or would adrenaline keep you up all night? Skylodge Adventure Suites in Sacred Valley, Cuzco, Peru, offer exactly this kind of unusual stay.
As one of the best unique hotels in the world for 2026, this cliffside hotel features transparent, vertically hanging capsule suites handcrafted from aerospace aluminum and weather-resistant polycarbonate, all clinging to the cliffs of Peru’s Sacred Valley. Each unit comes equipped with beds, pillows, blankets, a small dining area, and a bathroom, just like a regular hotel room.
The unique stay doesn’t end there. Reaching this cliffside hotel means climbing via ferrata route, a fixed climbing path on the rock face, or ziplining in, both becoming part of the adventure itself. Staying here means embracing extreme adventure alongside your night’s sleep, but every bit of the nerve-wracking climb pays off with the stunning views waiting at the top, from sweeping panoramas of the valley to breathtaking sunrises.
4. Giraffe Manor, Nairobi, Kenya – Wildlife Dining
If you’ve only ever seen giraffes through a TV screen or from behind a zoo fence, Giraffe Manor in Nairobi, Kenya, offers something else entirely: a stay where you interact with wild Rothschild giraffes roaming freely around the property.
Giraffe Manor is a boutique hotel with colonial-style architecture, set within a private sanctuary. Its limited rooms are notoriously hard to book and stay full year-round. Beyond the design, the surrounding scenery is lush and green, easy on the eyes at every turn.
Expect the unexpected at breakfast here: giraffes that often approach guests during breakfast, poking their heads through the windows to share the meal with you. Between the unique wildlife encounter and stunning architecture, Giraffe Manor earns its place on every traveler’s bucket list.
5. Treehotel, Harads, Sweden – Architect-Designed Treehouses
A treehouse is often a childhood dream that rarely comes true. But in Harads, Sweden, you can finally live it out by staying at Treehotel, one of the most unique treehouse hotels in the world.
Tucked away in Swedish Lapland’s forests just south of the Arctic Circle, this treehouse hotel blends cutting-edge architecture with environmental sustainability through avant-garde rooms suspended among the pine trees. Each one was custom-designed by renowned Scandinavian architects, from the mirror-clad Mirrorcube to the flying saucer-shaped UFO and the giant Bird’s Nest.
Despite being deep in the wilderness, guests still enjoy attentive service and thoughtful facilities, from solid insulation and comfortable beds to eco-friendly toilets. The experience even shifts with the seasons, with winter bringing a chance to catch the Northern Lights above the treetops and summer bringing the midnight sun that keeps the forest glowing well into the night.
6. Sextantio Le Grotte della Civita, Matera, Italy – Ancient Cave Rooms
Another unique hotel in the world worth visiting is Sextantio Le Grotte della Civita in Matera, Italy. This is an albergo diffuso, a “scattered hotel” concept where rooms are spread across a historic UNESCO World Heritage site rather than housed in a single building.
Staying here means sleeping inside an ancient cave, since the hotel is literally carved into 9,000-year-old cave dwellings. The rooms blend minimalist yet elegant design with antique furnishings and modern comforts, all set against original stone floors and walls, arched ceilings, and a candlelit atmosphere.
This hotel gives you the chance to sleep in a space humans first occupied thousands of years ago, letting you experience a Stone Age atmosphere wrapped in modern comfort. You’ll also wake up to breathtaking views straight into the river gorge and Murgia Materana Park, a landscape dotted with Paleolithic cave dwellings.
7. Null Stern Hotel, Swiss Alps – Open-Air Stargazing Suite
Ever imagined staying in a hotel room with no walls, right in the middle of a mountain range? It sounds strange, but that’s exactly the experience offered by Null Stern Hotel in the Swiss Alps.
Null Stern Hotel is one of the most unusual places to stay, with open-air rooms set up at several locations across the Alpine mountainside. You’ll find all the furniture and interior details of a regular hotel room, just without walls, a roof, or a door. The sky and stars become your ceiling, and the towering Alps become your walls.
Each morning, a butler serves your needs, whether that’s a cup of morning coffee or a breakfast basket delivered straight to your room. With this open-air concept, you get to take in a stunning 360-degree panoramic view, making it exactly the kind of experience you won’t find elsewhere.
8. Equipoise Resort – Eco-Luxury Bamboo Retreat
If you’re looking for a slice of tropical paradise, Equipoise Resort is one of the unique stays you’ll find on the island of Bali. This resort offers accommodation with architecture built entirely from bamboo and natural materials.
Located in Ubud, Bali, the resort’s design features flowing, curved lines that merge seamlessly with the terraced landscape surrounding it. Rather than relying on heavy concrete structures, the layout allows for natural cross-ventilation and unobstructed views into the forest canopy throughout.
What makes this bamboo villa so unique goes beyond its architecture; it’s also the eco-friendly philosophy woven into every part of the experience. Staying here means returning to nature and reconnecting with local culture, where sustainable design, exceptional service, and sustainable amenities come together with a high level of comfort and privacy, all in harmony with the open outdoors.
9. Manta Resort, Zanzibar – Floating Underwater Room
Being stranded in the middle of the ocean sounds like a nightmare for most people, but at Manta Resort, you can turn that exact feeling into a memorable stay. There’s no fear of not reaching land or going hungry and thirsty with no supplies in sight, because every need here is fully taken care of, nothing like the survival movies set at sea.
Located in the Zanzibar Archipelago, specifically Pemba Island, Tanzania, Manta Resort is a remote, secluded property floating in the Indian Ocean, home to Africa’s first underwater bedroom, letting you sleep surrounded by marine life below the surface. The resort offers a more exclusive kind of getaway, blending natural beauty with active marine conservation.
While it shares a similar concept with Conrad Maldives, this hotel feels far more raw and isolated, suited for anyone chasing an escape from everyday life. Here, you can reconnect with yourself and take in the grandeur of the ocean, watching fish and sea creatures drift past your bedroom walls.
10. The Bubble Tent Hotels, Various Locations – Transparent Glamping
As a kid, you probably dreamed of climbing inside a bubble and floating away with the wind. Today, that dream has turned into a real hotel concept found across countries like France, Belgium, Spain, and even Indonesia.
Bubble Tent Hotels offer a unique way to stay, letting you sleep inside a giant, crystal-clear sphere that looks just like the soap bubbles you used to blow as a child. These hotels are usually set in breathtaking locations, letting you wake up surrounded by nature without giving up any comfort.
This bubble concept has become a popular pick for romantic honeymoon stays in Indonesia, with several locations found right here in Bali. Staying in one gives you a fully immersive experience with nature, with nothing standing between you and the view.
What Makes Bali a Destination for Unique Stays?
If you’re looking for a truly unique stay, Bali itself offers no shortage of destinations where you can find exactly that. With its breathtaking natural landscapes, exotic culture and traditions, welcoming local community, and a wide range of accommodation concepts, the island stands out as something genuinely special.
One of the most unique hotels in Bali worth trying comes from Ini Vie Hospitality’s portfolio, including Equipoise Resort, an adults-only bamboo resort in Tegallalang, and Maar Resort, with its 180-degree rice field views in Payangan. The portfolio also features smart-integrated villas across Seminyak and Canggu, each one designed to feel completely different from a standard hotel stay.

title: 7 Villa Honeymoon di Ubud: View Cantik dan Floating Breakfast Terbaik
content:
Villa honeymoon di Ubud menjadi pilihan yang tepat saat merencanakan bulan madu di Bali karena memiliki aura romantis yang sulit ditemukan di tempat lain. Keinginan untuk merayakan momen spesial dalam suasana yang intim dan mewah adalah bentuk apresiasi diri yang layak diwujudkan.
Dari artikel ini kamu akan mendapatkan daftar rekomendasi tempat menginap untuk bulan madu di Ubud, mulai dari yang menawarkan pemandangan cantik hingga yang menawarkan pelayanan personal. Berikut adalah 7 villa honeymoon di Ubud, dengan pemandangan cantik dan floating breakfast terbaik.
Mengapa Memilih Villa Honeymoon di Ubud?
Memilih Ubud sebagai destinasi bulan madu bukan hanya mengikuti tren, tetapi juga merupakan keputusan yang tepat bagi pasangan yang mengutamakan privasi dan suasana tenang. Tak heran jika vila-vila di Ubud untuk honeymoon selalu menjadi pilihan favorit karena mampu menghadirkan pengalaman yang lebih personal dan berkesan.
1. Privasi Maksimal dan Ketenangan Alami
Berbeda dengan hotel pada umumnya, banyak vila honeymoon di Ubud, Bali dirancang dengan konsep tertutup yang menjaga privasi sepenuhnya. Dengan kolam renang pribadi, pasangan bisa menikmati waktu bersama tanpa gangguan, ditemani suara alam seperti aliran sungai dan hembusan angin di antara pepohonan.
2. Desain yang Selaras dengan Alam
Setiap butik resor di Ubud maupun vila memiliki karakter desain yang khas dan menyatu dengan lingkungan sekitarnya.
Konsep semi terbuka menghadirkan ruang yang terasa lebih hidup dengan udara segar dan pemandangan hijau.
Penggunaan material alami seperti kayu dan batu menciptakan suasana hangat, romantis, sekaligus estetis untuk mengabadikan momen.
3. Pengalaman Kuliner yang Lebih Personal
Menginap di vila menghadirkan pengalaman bersantap yang lebih intim dibandingkan resort untuk bulan madu pada umumnya.
Floating breakfast menjadi momen ikonik yang tidak boleh dilewatkan.
Candle light dinner di area pribadi dengan dekorasi bunga dan lilin menciptakan suasana romantis tanpa perlu keluar dari vila.
4. Destinasi Wellness dan Relaksasi
Sebagai pusat wellness di Bali, akomodasi di area ini memudahkan pasangan menikmati berbagai pengalaman relaksasi:
Layanan spa tradisional Bali langsung di dalam vila
Atmosfer yang tenang dan spiritual, ideal untuk memulihkan energi setelah rangkaian persiapan pernikahan
5. Lokasi Strategis untuk Eksplorasi
Meski terasa tersembunyi dan privat, Ubud tetap menawarkan akses mudah ke berbagai aktivitas menarik:
Galeri seni dan museum khas Bali
Kafe organik hingga restoran fine dining berkelas
Destinasi populer seperti Terasering Tegallalang dan Monkey Forest yang dapat dijangkau dengan singkat
Mengapa Honeymoon Butuh View Cantik & Floating Breakfast?
1. Menciptakan Memori Visual yang Kuat
Momen sering kali terekam kuat melalui apa yang kita lihat. Pemandangan lembah hijau, laut biru, atau siluet pegunungan mampu menjadi “jangkar” memori yang melekat dalam ingatan.
Secara psikologis, lingkungan yang asri juga membantu menurunkan stres sekaligus meningkatkan hormon kebahagiaan setelah melewati rangkaian persiapan pernikahan. Itulah mengapa memilih rekomendasi villa di Ubud untuk honeymoon dengan view yang indah terasa begitu penting
2. Eksklusivitas dan Privasi
Floating breakfast menghadirkan pengalaman mewah yang lebih personal, jauh dari suasana ramai restoran hotel. Kamu bisa menikmati sarapan di kolam renang pribadi tanpa perlu berbagi ruang dengan tamu lain.
Momen sederhana ini justru menjadi salah satu aktivitas santai di vila yang menciptakan ruang untuk berbincang lebih dalam dan menikmati kebersamaan tanpa distraksi.
3. Merayakan “Self-Reward”
Pemandangan yang memanjakan mata serta fasilitas eksklusif seperti sarapan terapung menjadi bentuk apresiasi untuk diri sendiri dan pasangan. Inilah salah satu hal romantis yang dilakukan saat honeymoon, di mana setiap detail terasa lebih bermakna dan berbeda dari liburan biasa.
Daftar 7 Villa Honeymoon Terbaik di Ubud
Asvara Villa menjadi pilihan ideal bagi pasangan yang mengutamakan privasi penuh dengan suasana yang hangat dan intim. Tipe unggulannya adalah One Bedroom Villa with Private Pool and Jacuzzi, di mana begitu memasuki area vila, suasana terasa benar-benar eksklusif hanya untuk berdua.
Keunikan utamanya terletak pada posisi jacuzzi yang berada tepat di samping kolam renang, menciptakan pengalaman relaksasi tanpa harus berpindah ruang. Desainnya modern, bersih, dan tetap terasa hangat dengan sentuhan minimalis yang Instagrammable, menjadikannya salah satu villa di Ubud yang aman dan privat untuk honeymoon.
Dengan harga mulai dari Rp2.400.000, kamu dan pasangan bisa menikmati waktu berdua tanpa gangguan, bahkan tanpa perlu banyak keluar kamar. Meski begitu, lokasinya tetap memungkinkan akses mudah ke berbagai aktivitas di Ubud, sehingga kamu tetap bisa menjelajahi saat ingin keluar sejenak dari suasana privat.
Asvara Resort mengusung konsep Luxury Romantic Resort dengan suasana yang lebih tenang dan megah, berlokasi di area Payangan yang masih asri dan jauh dari keramaian Ubud. Sebagai honeymoon resort di Ubud, tempat ini menawarkan pengalaman menginap yang lebih privat dengan nuansa alam yang kuat.
Setiap vila, mulai dari One Bedroom hingga Two Bedroom, dilengkapi dengan private pool, jacuzzi, Super King Size bed, Smart TV, hingga kamar mandi semi-terbuka yang mewah. Fasilitas ini dirancang untuk memberikan kenyamanan maksimal bagi pasangan dan dibandrol Rp2.900.000.
Untuk melengkapi pengalaman, tersedia Flairs Restaurant Ubud dengan hidangan Thailand autentik dan Svaha Spa Kelusa dengan treatment khusus pasangan. Romantic setup seperti floating breakfast, flower pool, dan candlelight dinner menjadikan resort ini pilihan ideal untuk honeymoon yang intimate dan berkesan.
Maar Resort Ubud merupakan salah satu permata terbaru dari Ini Vie Hospitality dengan fokus pada ketenangan dan koneksi dengan budaya lokal. Sebagai butik hotel di Ubud, resor ini menghadirkan suasana sanctuary yang damai, dengan dominasi elemen kayu hangat dan pencahayaan lembut.
Berbeda dari resort yang cenderung ramai, Maar Resort dirancang untuk pasangan yang ingin melambat dan menikmati keheningan Ubud secara lebih autentik. Pilihan unitnya beragam, mulai dari Suite Room hingga Two Bedroom Villa dengan private pool, dilengkapi bathtub luas, Smart TV, dan koneksi internet cepat untuk kenyamanan maksimal.
Highlight lainnya termasuk Cantina Classe, restoran Italia autentik dengan menu pizza dan pasta handmade, Svaha Spa at Maar yang berfokus pada healing dan relaksasi. Berlokasi di Payangan yang asri, hanya sekitar 10–15 menit dari Tegallalang dan pusat Ubud, harga resort ini mulai dari Rp2.600.000.
Amarea dikenal sebagai Luxury Art Resort yang menghadirkan perpaduan antara desain modern tropis dan sentuhan seni lokal yang kuat. Berlokasi di area Peliatan, resort ini menawarkan suasana tenang namun tetap dekat dengan pusat Ubud.
Pilihan akomodasinya cukup beragam, mulai dari suite room, cottage room, hingga one- dan two-bedroom villa dengan private pool, yang cocok untuk berbagai kebutuhan tamu. Di dalam area resort, terdapat Norii Ubud, restoran Jepang autentik dengan suasana romantis dan hangat, yang menyajikan menu seperti yakitori, sushi, dan hidangan panggangan khas Jepang.
Untuk melengkapi pengalaman, tersedia Svaha Spa Teges dengan treatment khusus pasangan serta berbagai layanan romantis seperti dekorasi bunga di kamar dan kolam, hingga floating breakfast. Lokasinya juga sangat strategis, hanya sekitar 5–10 menit dari pusat Ubud, resort ini menawarkan harga mulai dari Rp2.600.000 untuk per malamnya.
5. Kaamala Luxury Resort & Spa
Resort ini sering dianggap sebagai “standar emas” untuk akomodasi bulan madu di Ubud karena mampu memadukan kemewahan modern dengan pemandangan lembah hijau yang dramatis. Suasananya terasa mewah, romantis, dan sangat terawat, dengan atmosfer eksklusif yang sudah terasa sejak pertama kali memasuki area lobi.
Harga kamar di tempat ini mulai dari Rp2.800.000 per malam, dengan berbagai tipe luxury pool villa hingga suite room, sehingga mudah disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan pasangan. Setiap unit dilengkapi teknologi modern seperti Smart TV dengan Netflix, speaker Bluetooth, serta Smart Room System yang menambah kenyamanan selama menginap.
Untuk pengalaman kuliner, tersedia tiga restoran dengan konsep berbeda: Habitat Bistro, Shichirin Japanese Restaurant, dan Seven Paintings Ubud, yang masing-masing menawarkan pengalaman unik. Selain private pool di vila, kolam renang utamanya juga menjadi highlight karena posisinya menghadap tebing, menjadikannya spot foto favorit.
Fasilitas wellness hadir melalui Svaha Spa Bisma yang memadukan pijat tradisional Bali dengan pemandangan lembah yang menenangkan, serta didukung gym dan kapel kecil untuk wedding ceremony atau renewal vows. Berlokasi di Jalan Bisma yang tenang, resort ini tetap hanya berjarak sekitar 5–10 menit berjalan kaki dari pusat Ubud, Monkey Forest, serta berbagai butik dan kafe populer.
6. Aksari Luxury Resort & Spa
Aksari Resort Ubud sering dikenal sebagai salah satu destinasi paling romantis di Bali, terutama bagi pasangan yang ingin merasakan suasana “Bali yang autentik.” Resort ini menghadirkan nuansa mewah dan spiritual yang menyatu dengan alam, dengan desain melingkar mengikuti kontur tanah, sehingga menawarkan pemandangan 180 derajat ke arah hutan tropis yang hijau dan asri.
Pilihan akomodasinya beragam, mulai dari Grand One hingga Two Bedroom Villa dengan private pool, hingga suite room, semuanya dilengkapi sentuhan interior kayu yang hangat dan pemandangan hutan yang memukau. Untuk pengalaman kuliner, tersedia Kojin Japanese Restaurant dan Ankhusa Bali yang menyajikan hidangan autentik dengan latar alam yang menenangkan, serta kolam renang bertingkat yang ikonik mengikuti lereng bukit.
Fasilitas wellness dihadirkan melalui Svaha Spa Kenderan yang menawarkan pengalaman relaksasi sekaligus healing secara menyeluruh. Selain itu, Aksari juga dikenal dengan layanan perayaan yang lengkap, mulai dari kapel bambu, yoga venue, hingga romantic dinner dan floating breakfast.
Berlokasi di Tegallalang, resort ini menawarkan suasana yang lebih sejuk, tenang, dan dekat dengan area sawah terasering yang terkenal. Harga per malamnya mulai dari Rp3.100.000, dan dapat berubah tergantung musim serta promo yang berlaku.
Berbeda dengan resor yang menonjolkan pemandangan tebing, Dedary mengusung konsep “Heavenly Retreat” dengan suasana tenang di tengah hamparan sawah hijau dan deretan pohon kelapa di Desa Kendran. Desainnya memadukan elemen kayu dengan sentuhan modern, menciptakan nuansa hangat dan homey yang langsung terasa sejak pertama kali datang.
Setiap vila dirancang dengan tingkat privasi yang tinggi, dilengkapi dengan kolam renang pribadi yang menghadap taman tropis atau sawah. Pengalaman menginap semakin lengkap dengan kehadiran Sans Indian, restoran di dalam resor yang menyajikan hidangan India autentik dengan rasa yang kaya dan khas.
Suasana pagi terasa istimewa dengan floating breakfast di udara sejuk Ubud, lalu ditutup dengan couple massage di Svaha Spa Dedary yang menenangkan. Harga per malamnya mulai dari Rp3.700.000, dan dapat berubah tergantung musim atau pun promo yang berlaku.
Tips Memilih Villa untuk Honeymoon di Ubud
1. Tentukan Prioritas Pemandangan
Ubud memiliki dua karakter utama yang bisa disesuaikan dengan preferensi kalian. Pemandangan lembah dan hutan memberikan kesan dramatis dan privat, sementara view sawah menghadirkan suasana yang lebih tenang, terbuka, dan terasa lebih dekat dengan kehidupan pedesaan.
2. Pastikan Privasi Private Pool
Perhatikan apakah kolam renang dapat terlihat dari area umum atau vila lain. Untuk honeymoon, sebaiknya pilih vila dengan pembatas tinggi atau yang menghadap langsung ke alam terbuka seperti hutan atau lembah tanpa gangguan bangunan di sekitarnya.
3. Cek Kelengkapan Fasilitas Dalam Vila
Karena sebagian besar waktu akan dihabiskan di dalam kamar, pastikan fasilitasnya mendukung kenyamanan. Bathtub atau jacuzzi, smart TV, speaker, hingga layanan butler akan membuat pengalaman menginap terasa lebih maksimal.
4. Perhatikan Lokasi dan Akses
Area yang dekat dengan pusat Ubud seperti Jalan Bisma atau Monkey Forest cocok untuk pasangan yang masih ingin menjelajah kafe, butik, dan tempat wisata. Sementara lokasi yang lebih terpencil seperti Payangan atau Tegallalang menawarkan ketenangan penuh bagi yang ingin benar-benar menjauh dari keramaian.
5. Pilih Paket Honeymoon yang Tepat
Tidak hanya memesan kamar, pertimbangkan paket honeymoon yang biasanya sudah mencakup berbagai pengalaman tambahan. Mulai dari candle light dinner, spa untuk pasangan, hingga dekorasi bunga saat kedatangan yang membuat momen terasa lebih spesial.
Ini Vie Hospitality: Akomodasi Terbaik untuk Honeymoon
Memilih villa honeymoon di Ubud bukan hanya soal tempat menginap, tetapi tentang menciptakan pengalaman yang benar-benar berkesan, mulai dari privasi, pemandangan, hingga fasilitas yang mendukung momen intim bersama pasangan. Melalui berbagai pilihan villa dan resort yang telah dibahas, kamu bisa menyesuaikan gaya honeymoon sesuai preferensi, baik itu yang dekat pusat Ubud maupun yang tersembunyi di tengah alam yang tenang.
Ini Vie Hospitality menghadirkan berbagai pilihan akomodasi terbaik dengan konsep yang berbeda namun tetap mengutamakan kenyamanan, pelayanan personal, dan pengalaman romantis yang autentik. Untuk mendapatkan penawaran terbaik dan paket honeymoon eksklusif, kamu bisa langsung melakukan reservasi melalui website resmi Ini Vie Hospitality dan temukan pengalaman menginap yang dirancang khusus untuk momen spesialmu.

title: Top 10 Wedding Venues in Ubud for a Bali Destination Wedding
content:
A wedding venue in Ubud is more than just a place to say “I do”, it’s where nature, culture, and spirituality come together to create unforgettable memories. Planning a wedding here means celebrating love surrounded by lush rice fields, tropical forests, and a serene atmosphere that feels both magical and sacred.
With its breathtaking landscapes and intimate vibe, Ubud has become one of the most sought-after spots for a Bali destination wedding. To inspire your special day, here are the top 10 wedding venues in Ubud that promise a celebration as beautiful as the love you’re honoring:
1. Wedding Venue Aksari Resort
Aksari Resort Ubud offers one of the most enchanting Ubud wedding venues, blending elegant Balinese bamboo architecture with serene jungle views and a tranquil poolside setting. Intimate yet breathtaking, it’s the perfect spot for couples dreaming of a romantic celebration surrounded by nature.
The venue can host up to 75 guests, with two stunning ceremony options: the Aksari Wedding Chapel or the Infinity Pool. Packages like the Ultimate Aksari Wedding (from IDR 47,312,392++ for 50 guests) and the Aksari Infinity Water Wedding (from IDR 122,911,195++) include venue use, stylish décor, flower bouquets, a sound system, accommodation, spa treatments, and even live music.
For those looking to add more romantic things to do, a reception dinner at Ankhusa Restaurant completes the magical experience.
2. Dreamy Wedding Venue at Kaamala Resort Ubud
Kaamala Resort Ubud presents two stunning Ubud wedding venue options, each with its own unique charm. The Kaamala Wedding Chapel, with its sleek V-shaped design, opens up to lush jungle views, perfect for couples seeking an intimate, modern ceremony.
For a more tropical vibe, the infinity pool setting offers a breezy, open-air backdrop framed by the beauty of Ubud’s greenery. Capacity depends on the venue: the chapel welcomes up to 50 guests, while poolside ceremonies can host up to 70.
Wedding packages include the Glamorous Kaamala Wedding (from IDR 78,966,234++ for 70 guests) and the Kaamala Infinity Water Wedding (from IDR 122,911,195 for 50 guests). As one of the standout luxury hotels in Ubud, Kaamala ensures every detail is crafted for a wedding that’s as unforgettable as the setting
3. Kayon Resort Wedding
The Kayon Resort Ubud offers one of the most enchanting wedding settings in Bali, with its uniquely designed chapel floating on a lotus pond and overlooking the lush valley. This serene and magical venue creates a truly unforgettable atmosphere for your special day.
Couples can also choose other breathtaking backdrops, such as the tranquil banks of the Petanu River surrounded by jungle or the infinity pool area with sweeping forest views. Wedding packages here are tailored to suit intimate to medium-sized celebrations.
For couples seeking privacy, there are packages designed just for two, complete with a celebrant, floral décor, Balinese music, a wedding cake, and photography. Larger packages can include reception dinners, accommodations, and more, ensuring every detail is perfectly curated.
With its focus on peace and intimacy, The Kayon Resort is ideal for couples dreaming of a private yet magical celebration.
Maya Ubud offers a variety of stunning spaces for your special day, making it one of the most enchanting choices for an Ubud wedding villa. For intimate vows, the Ceremonial Plaza welcomes up to 50 guests, set high in the forest canopy with serene views of the Petanu River.
The Amphitheater, overlooking the valley, is perfect for larger outdoor receptions with space for 150 guests. For mid-sized gatherings, the Tree Bar Terrace offers a romantic setting for up to 70 guests, while private villa weddings host 20–30 people, ideal for intimate ceremonies, receptions, or after-parties.
As the number 1 destination for romance, Maya Ubud elevates weddings with thoughtfully designed packages like the Elopement Package, Eternal Matrimony Package, and Everlasting Matrimony Package.
Beyond the big day, couples can embrace the beauty of Ubud with serene forest walks, river views, and cultural experiences, perfect inspiration if you’re wondering what to do before or after your wedding celebration.
5. Alila Ubud wedding
Alila Ubud stands out as one of the best wedding venues in Ubud, offering breathtaking backdrops of river valleys and lush rainforests. Couples can choose from several unique settings: the Sculpture Garden for up to 100 guests, a romantic poolside terrace for 150, the Plantation Terrace for 120, or the Ayung Ballroom, which hosts up to 300 guests with elegant Balinese charm.
To make planning effortless, Alila offers tailored wedding packages in Ubud, Bali. From the intimate Simply for Two with a blessing ceremony and romantic dinner, to the Enchanted Hillside Wedding with flexible guest capacities and full services including photography, music, and bridal styling, each package ensures a seamless and unforgettable celebration.
6. Alaya Resort Ubud
Alaya Resort Ubud is a charming wedding venue in Ubud, Bali, offering romance and intimacy surrounded by tranquil rice paddies. Its highlight is the Wedding Pavilion, a 350-year-old Javanese joglo set above the fields, accessible by a scenic pathway that adds a sacred and traditional touch to the ceremony.
For larger celebrations, the resort also provides The Amphitheater, perfect for receptions of up to 200 guests. With flexible wedding packages, couples can even bring in outside organizers and decorators to personalize their big day.
After the vows, guests can enjoy culinary delights at Manisan, often praised as one of the best restaurants in Ubud, making the celebration both beautiful and unforgettable.
7. Kayumanis Resort Ubud
Kayumanis Ubud is a perfect small wedding venue in Ubud, offering intimate celebrations surrounded by tropical forests with stunning views of the Ayung River. Couples can choose from enchanting settings like the riverside, Wanderlust Garden, Royal Forest, or even a private Honeymoon Suite Villa for a truly romantic ceremony.
From elopements and Balinese blessing ceremonies to garden weddings, Kayumanis Ubud provides personalized service, luxury stays, and fine dining. Their curated wedding packages, such as the Uniquely Package, Prewedding Package, and Kayumanis Intimate Wedding, ensure every detail feels natural, elegant, and unforgettable.
Sthala Ubud offers four enchanting venues, each with its own charm. You can exchange vows at Abing Terraces with its lush forest and Wos River backdrop, celebrate by the Wos Riverside Deck for an intimate riverside ceremony, or host a stylish event at the Naga Rooftop Bar & Lounge.
Each space blends natural beauty with Ubud’s serene ambiance, making it a dream setting for couples. When looking at the average cost of a wedding in Bali, Sthala Ubud provides clear options.
Their Simply Sthala Wedding package starts at IDR 38,800,000 nett for two people, while the Enchanting Sthala Wedding begins at IDR 58,800,000 nett for 30 guests. For a more elevated experience, the Exquisite Sthala Wedding is priced from IDR 68,800,000 nett for 30 guests, each package offering exclusive use of stunning venues like the chapel, terraces, or riverside deck.
Kamandalu Ubud is one of the most enchanting places to tie the knot, offering wedding packages that range from IDR 4,000,000++ for a pre-wedding photo shoot to IDR 45,000,000++ for full-service ceremonies with overnight stays. Couples can choose from breathtaking venues like the Forest Deck for a serene and sacred feel or Alun Alun and Rumah Yoga for elegant celebrations, ensuring every detail suits your vision and budget.
If you’re wondering about the cost to have a wedding in Bali for 100 guests, Kamandalu has the ultimate option: the Your Private Love Story package. With this, you rent the entire resort exclusively, including accommodation for up to 62 guests, a wedding celebrant, and complete services, making it the perfect choice for couples who want unmatched privacy, luxury, and a truly unforgettable celebration.
10. Tanah Gajah Ubud
Tanah Gajah is often hailed as one of the most stunning and romantic wedding venues in Ubud, blending traditional Balinese charm with five-star luxury. Set within expansive gardens, this resort can host up to 500 guests, making it perfect for both grand celebrations and intimate gatherings.
Every detail is carefully crafted, with bespoke options that allow couples to design their dream day. The resort offers several packages to suit different styles of weddings. The Exclusive Wedding Buyout lets you rent the entire property, complete with accommodations, dining, spa treatments, private car service, and even activities in Ubud like trekking or cycling.
For a more refined affair, the Elegant Wedding Package delivers sophistication and charm. Meanwhile, the Intimate Wedding Package at Dua Dari Ubud offers a cozy, homelike venue in central Ubud, ideal for smaller ceremonies and popular for pre-wedding photoshoots.

title: Wellness Tourism in Bali: The Best Healing and Yoga Retreats 2026
content:
In recent years, wellness tourism in Indonesia, especially Bali, has been growing for tourists seeking peace for their souls. The country offers many destinations with rich traditions, cultures, and natural resources, supporting the wellness tourism concept.
Bali itself is known for having many nature-panoramic destinations, making the island perfect for tourists. They can maintain or increase physical, mental, or spiritual health through the nature of the island. Here is an explanation of wellness tourism in Bali for tourists to know more about the destinations.
What is Wellness Tourism?
According to KlikDokter and curated by dr. Gia Pratama, wellness tourism can be defined as a kind of tourism that focuses more on the enhancement or preservation of health. Tourists will find an experience to support physical, mental, and spiritual well-being.
Wellness tourism Bali did not emerge overnight. Its roots can be traced to ancient times when cultures around the world recognized the healing power of nature and rituals. Asia contributed to the development of yoga, meditation, massage, and herbal medicine, which became the key components of it.
Health and wellness tourism Bali provides you with several kinds of activities for tourists, which are:
Spa and Health Retreat: This is a key element of wellness tourism in Bali. Tourists can enjoy treatments designed for skin rejuvenation, starting from traditional massage, aromatherapy, and beauty care.
Yoga and Meditation: There are many wellness destinations in Indonesia, especially Bali, that offer yoga or meditation classes for beginners or professionals. This activity helps tourists to reduce stress, increase concentration, and balance the mind and body.
Recreation and Physical Activities: Bali wellness tourism offers experiences that involve physical activities , such as trekking in nature. It will help them to maintain their health and enjoy Bali’s amazing panoramic scenery.
With all those key elements, wellness tourism has become the next tourism industry in Indonesia.
Wellness Tourism in Indonesia’s Tourism Industry
As claimed by Kementerian Pariwisata Indonesia, wellness tourism is considered successful in leading Indonesian tourism in the Osaka World Expo 2025, presented through Kemenpar facilitation to strengthen it on a global level.
Kemenpar collaborated with Rumah Atsiri Indonesia, Mustika Ratu, and Taman Wisata Candi (TWC) to promote wellness tourism in Bali based on traditional elements, such as essential oils, room fragrances, traditional perfumes, packaged herbal drinks, and many products, which gained approximately 100.000 visitors.
Ni Made Ayu Marthini, Deputy of Marketing in the Ministry of Tourism, said that participation in the event increased the profile and exposure of Indonesian tourism, especially in the interest tourism, such as wellness tourism, gastronomy, and marine tourism.
It proves that wellness tourism has become popular among tourists to preserve their physical, mental, and spiritual well-being in Bali. Here are list of resorts, spas, and authentic Balinese healing to try!
Top Luxury Wellness Resorts in Bali
To enjoy the intent of seeking well-being in Bali, tourists can choose at least three top luxury wellness resorts that suit their needs, which are:
1. Equipoise Resort & Spa
Located in Ubud, Bali, Equipoise Resort and Spa offers tourists magnificent wellness and nourishing experiences through its services. Tourists are served welcome snacks upon arrival and an evening turndown to relax.
Also, tourists will have an amazing experience waking up to rice fields views in the morning, enjoying leisure time during a staycation with their partners. They can even personalize their rest with chosen soothing aromatherapy, helping them feel deep sleep after a day of exploring.
Tourists can also choose Kaamala Resort located in Ubud, Bali. The place features a romantic haven with natural elegance, featuring natural stone, wood textures, and tropical details, helping them to escape from the hustle and bustle.
Kaamala Resort also provides dining service through Habitat Resto serving a local cuisine and refined Italian specialities, Shichirin Ubud with an artistic Japanese culinary, and Seven Paintings Ubud, which unfold in a symphony of flavor where the meal course becomes a canvas served by a professional chef.
Aksari Resort offers tranquility to tourists seeking peace. The resort has many room options for them. The room itself is crafted for shared journeys, featuring a family estate in miniature with two luxurious suites, a magnificent living pavilion, and a vast pool.
This resting experience in Aksari Resort will help tourists to have boundless grace, promising laughter, and unforgettable moments in their lives. They can even astonishingly enjoy the meal in Ankhusa Ubud, serving Balinese royal dining, when each dish is crafted from local ingredients by skilled chefs.
Those resorts can be booked by tourists interested in wellness tourism to get peace. However, the destinations are not limited to resorts; Bali also offers tourists specialized healing places.
Specialized Healing: Spa, Massage & Sound Healing
Located in Seminyak, Tourists can try embracing the season of love at Svaha Spa, offering tranquility through gentle touch. Three services provided by the spas are Traditional Bali Aromatherapy, Traditional Bali Muscle Tension, and Traditional Bali Hot Stone.
Besides, Svaha Spa also provides tourists with two packages to enjoy the relaxation, encompassing Wellness Package: Svaha Retreat and Wellness Package: Sound Healing. The spa is spread across several Bali areas, and for a better experience, tourists can choose Svaha Spa in Canggu to relax in the heart of Bali’s prettiest destination.
Have a desire to experience the calming of Bali wellness tourism? Tourists can choose Hammana Spa to get the best massage, restoring balance through holistic rituals. The spa combines two types of massage, Wariga Bali and Turkish Hammam Tradition which gives a fantastic touch to the entire body.
Whether you’re looking to hit the reset button or simply find your center, Hammana Spa in Kenderan, Bali, offers a beautifully curated escape. Nestled in the lush landscapes of the Gianyar Regency, this sanctuary provides three signature pathways to restoration: The Serenity Ritual, The Nature Rebirth, and The Inner Peace Journey.
If indulging in a luxurious spa experience is not enough yet, tourists can explore Authentic Balinese Healing, one of the finest wellness tourism Bali, combining spiritual ritual, energy balancing, herbal remedies, and traditional massage.
Authentic Balinese Healing
According to iNi Vie, Melukat is one of the spiritual cleansings coming from Balinese Hinduism. Melukat itself is taken from the word ‘sulukat’, meaning ‘doing good deeds to cleanse the soul from negative things’. The ritual intends to cleanse the body and soul spiritually.
It is recommended to choose Manuba Waterfall if tourists want to experience the best melukat ritual in Bali. To join the trip, Tourists can access the Equipoise website and follow all the melukat steps, including dining, trekking, healing ritual, and yoga.
Besides, there are several places to Melukat outside Manuba Waterfall, which are Taman Beji Griya Waterfall – Badung, Pura Tirta Sudamala – Bangli, and Pura Tirta Empul – Gianyar. These places are also famous among the locals and tourists.
One of the most popular authentic healing treatments in health and wellness tourism Bali is sound healing. This healing treatment will help the tourists who are struggling with anxiety and depression. Usually, therapists will use traditional musical instruments, such as gamelan, suling, or a singing bowl, to soothe tourists’ heads and minds.
Sound healing has three key elements for tourists looking for health and wellness tourism Bali, which are:
Emotional and Mental Release: It helps tourists to release stored emotional tension, anxiety, and deep-seated emotions that are hard to express through words.
Deep Relaxation and Stress Reduction: Sound baths with singing bowls and gongs will trigger an intimate state of relaxation and calm the nervous system, reducing anxiety and lowering blood pressure and heart rate.
Improved Sleep: A gentle tone from the musical instruments will reset the body’s natural sleep rhythms, helping tourists have deep sleep and proper rest.
